          <td>${noaaHeight(r.wwh, useMetric)}</td>
          <td>${r.wwp || ''}</td>
          <td>${r.wwd || ''}</td>
          <td>${r.steepness || ''}</td>
          <td>${r.apd || ''}</td>
        `;

        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      });
    }

    // Dispatch on source: NDBC keeps the rich NOAA summary + spectral-partition panel;
    // every other source (CDIP / AODN / QLD / AusWaves) gets the adaptive bulk panel.
    function loadLiveBuoyDetails(station) {
      const seq = ++liveDetailSeq;
      try { document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('allshore:livepanel')); } catch (e) {}   // the panel opens for a buoy (every source): bring it forward
      const src = (station.source || '').toUpperCase();
      if (src === 'NDBC' || /^ndbc:/i.test(station.id || '')) {
        return loadNdbcBuoyDetails(station, seq);
      }
      return loadGenericBuoyDetails(station, seq);
    }

    async function loadNdbcBuoyDetails(station, seq) {
      showLiveBuoyPanelLoading(station);
      const stale = () => seq !== liveDetailSeq;   // superseded or panel closed

      // Merged-feed ids are namespaced ("ndbc:46221"); the NDBC routes want the raw id.
      const rawId = (station.id || '').replace(/^ndbc:/i, '');

      // Both requests start together (they were sequential); the summary still decides what
      // is shown first. The noop catch keeps an unused/failed components request quiet --
      // the real failure handling happens where it is awaited below.
      const summaryRequest = fetch('/api/ndbc/station/' + encodeURIComponent(rawId) + '/wave-summary');
      const componentRequest = fetch('/api/ndbc/station/' + encodeURIComponent(rawId) + '/components');
      componentRequest.catch(function () {});

      try {
        const summaryResponse = await summaryRequest;

        const summaryData = await summaryResponse.json();
        if (stale()) return;

        if (!summaryResponse.ok || summaryData.error) {
          throw new Error(summaryData.error || 'Unable to load NOAA wave summary.');
        }

        // Nothing within the freshness window -> show "No Recent Reports" only.
        // Skip the spectral fetch too: those files are just as stale.
        if (summaryData.no_recent_reports) {
          lastNoaaWaveSummaryData = summaryData;
          lastLiveComponentData = null;
          lastNoRecentStation = station;
          showLiveBuoyNoRecent(summaryData, station);
          return;
        }
        lastNoRecentStation = null;

        renderNoaaWaveSummary(summaryData);

        try {
          const componentResponse = await componentRequest;

          const componentData = await componentResponse.json();
          if (stale()) return;

          // The spectral files can lag the .spec summary; don't render a stale
          // snapshot next to fresh summary values.
          if (componentResponse.ok && !componentData.error && !componentData.no_recent_reports) {
            // Make sure Chart.js is present for the spectrum plot; if the load fails the
            // render throws exactly as it would have with the CDN down before.
            try { await loadChartJs(); } catch (chartErr) {}
            if (stale()) return;
            renderLiveBuoyDetails(componentData);
          }
        } catch (componentErr) {
          console.warn('Experimental spectral component load failed:', componentErr);
        }
        if (stale()) return;

        document.getElementById('liveBuoyLoading').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('liveBuoyError').classList.add('d-none');
        document.getElementById('liveBuoyGeneric').classList.add('d-none');
        document.getElementById('liveBuoyContent').classList.remove('d-none');

      } catch (err) {
        if (stale()) return;
        showLiveBuoyError(err.message);
      }
    }

    // ---- Adaptive bulk panel (non-NDBC sources) ----
    function fmtHeightM(m, useMetric) {
      const n = Number(m);
      if (m === null || m === undefined || !Number.isFinite(n)) return '—';
      return useMetric ? n.toFixed(2) + ' m' : (n * 3.28084).toFixed(1) + ' ft';
    }
    function fmtPeriod(s) {
      const n = Number(s);
      return Number.isFinite(n) ? n.toFixed(1) + ' s' : '—';
    }
    function fmtDir(d) {
      const n = Number(d);
      if (d === null || d === undefined || !Number.isFinite(n)) return '—';
      return Math.round(((n % 360) + 360) % 360) + '° ' + compassPoint(n);
    }
    function fmtTemp(c, useMetric) {
      const n = Number(c);
      if (c === null || c === undefined || !Number.isFinite(n)) return '—';
      return useMetric ? n.toFixed(1) + ' °C' : (n * 9 / 5 + 32).toFixed(1) + ' °F';
    }
    function relativeAge(iso) {
      const t = Date.parse(iso);
      if (!Number.isFinite(t)) return iso || '—';
      const mins = Math.max(0, Math.round((Date.now() - t) / 60000));
      if (mins < 60) return mins + ' min ago';
      const hrs = Math.round(mins / 60);
      if (hrs < 48) return hrs + ' h ago';
      return Math.round(hrs / 24) + ' d ago';
    }

    // Format a UTC ISO time in a specific IANA zone (the buoy's own zone); falls back
    // to the viewer's local zone when tz is missing.
    function fmtTimeInTz(iso, tz) {
      const d = new Date(iso);
      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '—';
      const opts = { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' };
      if (tz) opts.timeZone = tz;
      try { return d.toLocaleString([], opts); }
      catch (e) { delete opts.timeZone; return d.toLocaleString([], opts); }
    }
    // Short zone abbreviation (e.g. "AEST", "AWST", "GMT+10") for a given time + zone. A nautical zone reads as the
    // forecast window writes it ("Etc/GMT+8" -> "UTC−8", not Intl's "GMT-8": one name on one screen, G22 R-B4).
    function tzAbbr(iso, tz) {
      if (/^Etc\//.test(tz || '') && window.AllshoreForecast && window.AllshoreForecast.zoneLabel) return window.AllshoreForecast.zoneLabel(tz);
      try {
        const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US',
          { timeZone: tz || undefined, timeZoneName: 'short' }).formatToParts(new Date(iso));
        return (parts.find(p => p.type === 'timeZoneName') || {}).value || '';
      } catch (e) { return ''; }
    }

    function buildRecentTable(recent, useMetric, tz) {
      if (!recent || !recent.length) return '';
      const hasPeriod = recent.some(o => o.mean_period_s != null || o.tz_s != null);
      const hasSST = recent.some(o => o.sst_c != null);
      const heightUnit = useMetric ? 'm' : 'ft';
      const tempUnit = useMetric ? '°C' : '°F';
      const abbr = tzAbbr(recent[0].time_utc, tz);

      const head =
        '<tr><th>Time' + (abbr ? '<br><span class="small">' + abbr + '</span>' : '') + '</th>' +
        '<th>Hs<br><span class="small">' + heightUnit + '</span></th>' +
        '<th>Tp<br><span class="small">sec</span></th>' +
        (hasPeriod ? '<th>Avg Pd<br><span class="small">sec</span></th>' : '') +
        '<th>Dir</th>' +
        (hasSST ? '<th>SST<br><span class="small">' + tempUnit + '</span></th>' : '') + '</tr>';

      const body = recent.map(o => {
        const pd = (o.tz_s != null) ? o.tz_s : o.mean_period_s;
        return '<tr>' +
          '<td class="text-nowrap">' + (o.time_utc ? fmtTimeInTz(o.time_utc, tz) : '—') + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + fmtHeightM(o.hs_m, useMetric).replace(' ' + heightUnit, '') + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + (Number.isFinite(Number(o.tp_s)) ? Number(o.tp_s).toFixed(1) : '—') + '</td>' +
          (hasPeriod ? '<td>' + (Number.isFinite(Number(pd)) ? Number(pd).toFixed(1) : '—') + '</td>' : '') +
          '<td class="text-nowrap">' + fmtDir(o.dir_deg) + '</td>' +
          (hasSST ? '<td>' + (Number.isFinite(Number(o.sst_c)) ? fmtTemp(o.sst_c, useMetric).replace(' ' + tempUnit, '') : '—') + '</td>' : '') +
          '</tr>';
      }).join('');

      return '<h6 class="mt-3 mb-2">Recent observations (last 24 h)</h6>' +
        '<div class="table-responsive" style="max-height:260px;overflow-y:auto;">' +
        '<table class="table table-sm table-bordered align-middle mb-0">' +
        '<thead class="table-light">' + head + '</thead><tbody>' + body + '</tbody></table></div>';
    }

    // Swell / wind-sea component table (a 2-way sea/swell split, or NDBC-style
    // multi-partition components — same shape either way: [{label,hs_m,period_s,dir_deg,spread_deg}]).
    function buildPartitionTable(partitions, useMetric, title) {
      if (!partitions || !partitions.length) return '';
      const hasSpread = partitions.some(p => p.spread_deg != null);
      const hasEnergy = partitions.some(p => p.energy_pct != null);
      const rows = partitions.map(p =>
        '<tr><td class="text-nowrap"><strong>' + p.label + '</strong></td>' +
        '<td>' + fmtHeightM(p.hs_m, useMetric) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + fmtPeriod(p.period_s) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="text-nowrap">' + fmtDir(p.dir_deg) + '</td>' +
        (hasSpread ? '<td>' + (Number.isFinite(Number(p.spread_deg)) ? Math.round(p.spread_deg) + '°' : '—') + '</td>' : '') +
        (hasEnergy ? '<td>' + (Number.isFinite(Number(p.energy_pct)) ? Math.round(p.energy_pct) + '%' : '—') + '</td>' : '') +
        '</tr>'
      ).join('');
      return '<h6 class="mt-3 mb-2">' + (title || 'Wave components') + '</h6>' +
        '<table class="table table-sm table-bordered align-middle mb-2" style="max-width:600px;">' +
        '<thead class="table-light"><tr><th>Component</th><th>Height</th><th>Period</th><th>Direction</th>' +
        (hasSpread ? '<th>Spread</th>' : '') + (hasEnergy ? '<th>Energy</th>' : '') +
        '</tr></thead><tbody>' + rows + '</tbody></table>';
    }

    // NDBC-style swell + wind-sea components OVER TIME. rows: [{time_utc, hs_m,
    // swell:{hs_m,period_s,dir_deg}, windsea:{hs_m,period_s,dir_deg}}], newest first.
    function buildSwellTable(rows, useMetric, tz) {
      rows = (rows || []).filter(r => r && (r.swell || r.windsea));
      if (!rows.length) return '';
      const hu = useMetric ? 'm' : 'ft';
      const abbr = tzAbbr(rows[0].time_utc, tz);
      const H = v => Number.isFinite(Number(v)) ? fmtHeightM(v, useMetric).replace(' ' + hu, '') : '—';
      const P = v => Number.isFinite(Number(v)) ? Number(v).toFixed(1) : '—';
      const D = v => Number.isFinite(Number(v)) ? (Math.round(v) + '° ' + compassPoint(v)) : '—';
      const body = rows.map(r => {
        const sw = r.swell || {}, ws = r.windsea || {};
        return '<tr><td class="text-nowrap">' + (r.time_utc ? fmtTimeInTz(r.time_utc, tz) : '—') + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + H(r.hs_m) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + H(sw.hs_m) + '</td><td>' + P(sw.period_s) + '</td><td class="text-nowrap">' + D(sw.dir_deg) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + H(ws.hs_m) + '</td><td>' + P(ws.period_s) + '</td><td class="text-nowrap">' + D(ws.dir_deg) + '</td></tr>';
      }).join('');
      return '<h6 class="mt-3 mb-2">Swell & wind-sea (last 24 h)</h6>' +
        '<div class="table-responsive" style="max-height:280px;overflow-y:auto;">' +
        '<table class="table table-sm table-bordered align-middle mb-0">' +
        '<thead class="table-light"><tr>' +
        '<th rowspan="2" class="align-middle">Time' + (abbr ? '<br><span class="small">' + abbr + '</span>' : '') + '</th>' +
        '<th rowspan="2" class="align-middle">Hs<br><span class="small">' + hu + '</span></th>' +
        '<th colspan="3" class="text-center">Swell</th><th colspan="3" class="text-center">Wind sea</th></tr>' +
        '<tr><th>H<br><span class="small">' + hu + '</span></th><th>P<br><span class="small">s</span></th><th>Dir</th>' +
        '<th>H<br><span class="small">' + hu + '</span></th><th>P<br><span class="small">s</span></th><th>Dir</th></tr>' +
        '</thead><tbody>' + body + '</tbody></table></div>';
    }

    // AusWaves carries the 2-way split in every recent obs row -> build the over-time table.
    function recentToSummary(recent) {
      const out = [];
      (recent || []).forEach(o => {
        if (!o.partitions) return;
        const sw = o.partitions.find(p => p.label === 'Swell');
        const ws = o.partitions.find(p => p.label === 'Wind sea');
        if (!sw && !ws) return;
        out.push({
          time_utc: o.time_utc, hs_m: o.hs_m,
          swell: sw ? { hs_m: sw.hs_m, period_s: sw.period_s, dir_deg: sw.dir_deg } : null,
          windsea: ws ? { hs_m: ws.hs_m, period_s: ws.period_s, dir_deg: ws.dir_deg } : null
        });
      });
      return out;
    }

    // ---- AODN directional-spectrum rendering (partitions + spectral-density chart) ----
    let genericSpectrumChart = null;
    let lastGenericSpectra = null;

    function renderGenericSpectrumChart(spectrum) {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('genericSpectrumCanvas');
      if (!canvas || typeof Chart === 'undefined') return;
      if (genericSpectrumChart) { genericSpectrumChart.destroy(); genericSpectrumChart = null; }
      const spec = (spectrum || [])
        .filter(p => Number.isFinite(Number(p.frequency_hz)) && Number.isFinite(Number(p.density_m2_per_hz)))
        .sort((a, b) => Number(a.frequency_hz) - Number(b.frequency_hz));
      if (!spec.length) return;
      const periodTicks = [40, 20, 15, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2].map(period => ({ period, value: 1 / period }));
      const xv = spec.map(p => Number(p.frequency_hz));
      const xMin = Math.min(...xv), xMax = Math.max(...xv);
      genericSpectrumChart = new Chart(canvas.getContext('2d'), {
        type: 'line',
        data: { datasets: [{ label: 'Spectral density', tension: 0.25, showLine: true, pointRadius: 2, borderWidth: 2,
          data: spec.map(p => ({ x: Number(p.frequency_hz), y: Number(p.density_m2_per_hz) })) }] },
        options: {
          responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, animation: false, parsing: false,
          plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: {
            title: items => `${formatComponentPeriodValue((spec[items[0].dataIndex] || {}).period_sec)} sec`,
            label: item => {
              const p = spec[item.dataIndex] || {};
              const l = ['Density: ' + item.formattedValue + ' m²/Hz'];
              if (p.direction_deg != null) l.push('Direction: ' + p.direction_deg + '°');
              return l;
            } } } },
          scales: {
            x: { type: 'linear', min: xMin, max: xMax,
              afterBuildTicks: scale => { scale.ticks = periodTicks.filter(t => t.value >= scale.min && t.value <= scale.max).map(t => ({ value: t.value, period: t.period })); },
              ticks: { autoSkip: false, maxRotation: 0, minRotation: 0, callback: (v, i, ticks) => (ticks[i] && ticks[i].period != null ? ticks[i].period.toString() : '') },
              title: { display: true, text: 'Period, seconds' } },
            y: { beginAtZero: true, title: { display: true, text: 'Energy density, m²/Hz' } }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function renderGenericSpectra(data, useMetric, tz) {
      lastGenericSpectra = data;
      const host = document.getElementById('genericSpectra');
      if (!host || !data) return;
      const parts = (data.components || []).map(c => ({
        label: c.type === 'wind sea' ? 'Wind sea'
          : (c.type ? c.type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.type.slice(1) : 'Component'),
        hs_m: c.height_m, period_s: c.peak_period_sec, dir_deg: c.direction_deg,
        spread_deg: c.directional_spread_deg, energy_pct: c.energy_percent
      }));
      host.innerHTML =
        buildSwellTable(data.summary, useMetric, tz) +
        buildPartitionTable(parts, useMetric, 'Current components (directional spectrum)') +
        '<h6 class="mt-3 mb-2">Spectral density (latest)</h6>' +
        '<div style="position:relative;height:200px;"><canvas id="genericSpectrumCanvas"></canvas></div>';
      renderGenericSpectrumChart(data.spectrum);
    }

    function renderGenericBuoy(payload, station) {
      lastGenericBuoy = { payload: payload, station: station };

      const useMetric = getSelectedUnit() === 'Metric';
      const o = (payload && payload.latest) || null;
      // Prefer the per-station capabilities (the /latest route only carries the
      // provider's class-level defaults, which don't know which buoys have spectra).
      const caps = (station && station.capabilities) || (payload && payload.capabilities) || {};
      const el = document.getElementById('liveBuoyGeneric');

      // innerHTML below replaces the spectra canvas; drop the stale chart instance.
      if (genericSpectrumChart) { genericSpectrumChart.destroy(); genericSpectrumChart = null; }

      if (!o) {
        el.innerHTML = '<div class="text-muted">No recent observation is available for this buoy.</div>';
      } else {
        const metrics = [['Sig. Height', fmtHeightM(o.hs_m, useMetric)]];
        if (o.hmax_m != null) metrics.push(['Max Height', fmtHeightM(o.hmax_m, useMetric)]);
        metrics.push(['Peak Period', fmtPeriod(o.tp_s)]);
        if (o.mean_period_s != null) metrics.push(['Mean Period', fmtPeriod(o.mean_period_s)]);
        if (o.tz_s != null) metrics.push(['Zero-cross Tz', fmtPeriod(o.tz_s)]);
        metrics.push(['Direction', fmtDir(o.dir_deg)]);
        if (o.dir_spread_deg != null && Number.isFinite(Number(o.dir_spread_deg)))
          metrics.push(['Dir. Spread', Math.round(o.dir_spread_deg) + '°']);
        if (o.sst_c != null) metrics.push(['Sea Temp', fmtTemp(o.sst_c, useMetric)]);

        const cards = metrics.map(m =>
          `<div class="live-buoy-metric"><div class="label">${m[0]}</div><div class="value fs-6">${m[1]}</div></div>`
        ).join('');

        const tz = (station && station.tz) || null;
        const abbr = o.time_utc ? tzAbbr(o.time_utc, tz) : '';
        const obs = o.time_utc
          ? `${relativeAge(o.time_utc)} · ${fmtTimeInTz(o.time_utc, tz)}${abbr ? ' ' + abbr : ''}`
          : '—';
        const tzNote = (tz && o.time_utc)
          ? `<div class="small text-muted mb-2">Times shown in buoy-local zone: ${tz}${abbr ? ' (' + abbr + ')' : ''}</div>`
          : '';

        const swellRows = recentToSummary(payload.recent);
        const hasParts = swellRows.length > 0;
        const hasHistory = payload.recent && payload.recent.length;
        el.innerHTML =
          `<div class="live-buoy-summary mb-2">${cards}</div>` +
          `<div class="small text-muted mb-1">Observed: ${obs}</div>` +
          tzNote +
          buildSwellTable(swellRows, useMetric, tz) +
          buildRecentTable(payload.recent, useMetric, tz) +
          (!hasHistory
            ? '<div class="small text-muted mt-2">Latest reading shown — this source does not publish recent history openly.</div>'
            : '') +
          (caps.spectra ? '' :
            (hasParts
              ? '<div class="small text-muted mt-2">Swell / wind-sea split from the buoy (2 components). Full directional spectra are not published for this buoy.</div>'
              : '<div class="small text-muted mt-2">Spectral / directional-partition data is not published for this buoy — bulk wave parameters only.</div>')) +
          (payload.attribution_text
            ? `<div class="small text-muted mt-2">${payload.attribution_text}</div>` : '');
      }

      // Placeholder filled later by renderGenericSpectra() for spectra-capable buoys.
      el.innerHTML += '<div id="genericSpectra"></div>';

      document.getElementById('liveBuoyLoading').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('liveBuoyError').classList.add('d-none');
      document.getElementById('liveBuoyContent').classList.add('d-none');
      el.classList.remove('d-none');
    }

    async function loadGenericBuoyDetails(station, seq) {
      showLiveBuoyPanelLoading(station);
      const stale = () => seq !== liveDetailSeq;   // superseded or panel closed
      lastGenericSpectra = null;
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/buoys/' + encodeURIComponent(station.id) + '/latest');
        const payload = await resp.json();
        if (stale()) return;
        if (!resp.ok || payload.error) {
          throw new Error(payload.error || 'Unable to load buoy observation.');
        }
        renderGenericBuoy(payload, station);

        // Spectra-capable buoys (AODN): pull the directional spectrum -> NDBC-style
        // partitions + spectral-density chart. Optional/lazy — never blocks the bulk view.
        if (station.capabilities && station.capabilities.spectra) {
          try {
            const cr = await fetch('/api/buoys/' + encodeURIComponent(station.id) + '/components');
            if (cr.ok) {
              const cdata = await cr.json();
              if (stale()) return;
              if (!cdata.error) {
                try { await loadChartJs(); } catch (chartErr) {}
                if (stale()) return;
                renderGenericSpectra(cdata, getSelectedUnit() === 'Metric', station.tz);
              }
            }
          } catch (specErr) {
            console.warn('Spectral partition load failed:', specErr);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (stale()) return;
        showLiveBuoyError(err.message);
      }
    }

    const unitSelect = document.getElementById('unit');

    if (unitSelect) {
      unitSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
        // A "No Recent Reports" panel has no values to convert -- keep it as-is.
        if (lastNoRecentStation) {
          showLiveBuoyNoRecent(lastNoaaWaveSummaryData, lastNoRecentStation);
          return;
        }

        if (lastNoaaWaveSummaryData) {
          renderNoaaWaveSummary(lastNoaaWaveSummaryData);
        }

        if (lastLiveComponentData) {
          // Re-render reads the CURRENT unit at render time, so a toggle made while
          // Chart.js is still loading is never lost -- it is applied once the load settles.
          const rerender = () => { if (lastLiveComponentData) renderLiveBuoyDetails(lastLiveComponentData); };
          if (window.Chart) rerender(); else loadChartJs().then(rerender, rerender);
        }

        if (lastGenericBuoy) {
          const keepSpectra = lastGenericSpectra;
          const stTz = lastGenericBuoy.station && lastGenericBuoy.station.tz;
          renderGenericBuoy(lastGenericBuoy.payload, lastGenericBuoy.station);
          if (keepSpectra) {
            const rerenderSpectra = () => {
              if (lastGenericSpectra === keepSpectra) renderGenericSpectra(keepSpectra, getSelectedUnit() === 'Metric', stTz);
            };
            if (window.Chart) rerenderSpectra(); else loadChartJs().then(rerenderSpectra, rerenderSpectra);
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function createLiveBuoyIcon(isActive = false) {
      const size = isActive ? 15 : 11;
      const centerOffsetPx = isActive ? 8 : 7;
      const anchorX = Math.round((size / 2) - centerOffsetPx);

      return L.divIcon({
        className: 'live-buoy-div-icon',
        html: `
          <span class="live-buoy-dot" style="
            width:${size}px;
            height:${size}px;
            background:#00E5FF;
            border:${isActive ? '3px solid #ffffff' : '2px solid #ffffff'};
            box-shadow:${isActive ? '0 0 10px rgba(0, 229, 255, 1)' : '0 0 6px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.9)'};
          "></span>
        `,
        iconSize: [size, size],

        // Places the live buoy about 7–8 px right of the actual coordinate.
        // Close enough to visually pair with the forecast buoy, but separated enough to click.
        iconAnchor: [anchorX, Math.round(size / 2)]
      });
    }

    // Build the two icon variants once and reuse them, instead of allocating a
    // fresh divIcon (with a box-shadow) for every marker on every rebuild.
    const liveBuoyIconInactive = createLiveBuoyIcon(false);
    const liveBuoyIconActive = createLiveBuoyIcon(true);

    function rebuildLiveBuoyMarkers(force = false) {
      const vis = visibleCopies(liveStationsData);
      // The active-buoy highlight changes the icon, so fold it into the signature.
      const sig = (activeLiveBuoyId || '') + '|' + renderSignature(vis);
      if (!force && sig === lastLiveSig) return;
      lastLiveSig = sig;

      liveBuoyLayer.clearLayers();

      vis.forEach(function (c) {
        const s = c.s;
        const label = 'Live ' + buoyDisplayLabel(s) + (s.source ? ' (' + s.source + ')' : '');
        const marker = L.marker([s.lat, c.lng], {
          icon: s.id === activeLiveBuoyId ? liveBuoyIconActive : liveBuoyIconInactive,
          title: label,
          zIndexOffset: 500
        }).addTo(liveBuoyLayer);

        marker.bindTooltip(textTip(label), {                       // a provider's station name: text, never HTML (G22 A-20)
          permanent: false,
          direction: 'top',
          offset: [12, -2]
        });

        marker.on('click', function (e) {
          if (window.AllshoreTools && window.AllshoreTools.active()) { window.AllshoreTools.click(e.latlng, e.originalEvent); return; }   // markers do not pass clicks to the map
          activeLiveBuoyId = s.id;
          rebuildLiveBuoyMarkers(true);
          saveMapView(map);
          saveLayerVisibility();
          loadLiveBuoyDetails(s);
        });
      });
    }

    // Wire map movement after all wrapped-marker state and rebuild functions exist.
    map.on('moveend', handleMapMoveEnd);
    map.on('zoomend', clampMapLatitude);

    window.addEventListener('resize', enforceSingleWorld);
    enforceSingleWorld();

    // ---------------- Favorite-station picker ----------------
    // Progressive enhancement over the native <select id="station">: the trigger
    // shows the current station (+ a ★ to favorite it) and opens a panel listing
    // saved favorites for one-tap selection. Most buoys are picked on the map; this
    // box is for quick re-access. The native select stays the real form field
    // (no-JS fallback) and ?station=... deep links are unaffected.
    (function initStationPicker() {
      const field = document.querySelector('.station-field');
      const select = document.getElementById('station');
      const trigger = document.getElementById('stationTrigger');
      const favToggle = document.getElementById('stationFavToggle');
      const currentEl = document.getElementById('stationCurrent');
      const results = document.getElementById('stationResults');
      const status = document.getElementById('stationStatus');
      if (!field || !select || !trigger || !favToggle || !currentEl || !results || !select.options.length) return;

      // every option of the select, the stations and My points (the page block adds those as an optgroup and says
      // so with 'allshore:points')

      onPoint: true && window.__allshorePoints ? function (ll) { return window.__allshorePoints.add(ll); } : null,
      // an expanded window that covers the tool bar is minimised when a tool starts and whenever the bar grows (owner,
      // G20 and its re-review); a window opened later stays until the bar grows again
      onLayout: function (bar, grew) {
        measureTopRight();
        if (!grew) return;
        var b = bar.getBoundingClientRect(), had = document.activeElement;
        [['liveBuoyPanel', 'lwMin'], ['forecastWin', 'fwMin']].forEach(function (w) {
          var el = document.getElementById(w[0]), min = document.getElementById(w[1]);
          if (!el || !min || el.hidden || el.classList.contains('fw-min')) return;
          var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (!(r.left < b.right && r.right > b.left && r.top < b.bottom && r.bottom > b.top)) return;
          min.click();
          // minimising moves focus to the window's opener; keep it where it was (the tool keeps its keys): back on the
          // element, else (the page itself, or an element now hidden or gone) off the opener; focus that was inside the
          // window stays with its opener
          if (had && el.contains(had)) return;
          if (had && had !== document.body && document.contains(had)) try { had.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (e) { /* no focus */ }
          if (document.activeElement !== had && document.activeElement && document.activeElement !== document.body) document.activeElement.blur();
        });
      },
      // the floating windows are obstacles for the exposure fan
      obstacles: function () { return [document.getElementById('forecastWin'), document.getElementById('liveBuoyPanel')]; },
      // on a short map the overlay panel's details leave no room for the fan: they fold when the exposure tool starts
      // (owner, G20 re-review; the ▸ button shows them again)
      onStart: function (bar, tool) {
        if (tool !== 'exposure' || map.getContainer().clientHeight >= 550) return;
        var t = map.getContainer().querySelector('.ov-toggle[aria-expanded="true"]');
        if (t) t.click();
      }
    });
  </script>

  <script defer src="https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js" data-cf-beacon='{"token": "5cb8e83a86034ae2a3980001b33c0b31"}'></script>
  <!-- End Cloudflare Web Analytics -->

  <script>
    // Start the two map-data requests NOW, before the browser parses the (large) forecast
    // table and station list below; the map script picks the responses up when it runs.
    // A rejection here is handled by the consumer's own .catch (the noop keeps it from
    // surfacing as "unhandled" in the meantime).
    window.__early = {
      live: fetch('/api/buoys/live-stations'),
      stations: fetch('/stations.json')
    };
    window.__early.live.catch(function () {});
    window.__early.stations.catch(function () {});
    // ---- early forecast (tests/ui/early.test.js runs this block: keep it self-contained between the markers) ----
    // The forecast window's first request, started here instead of after the page and its module have loaded.
    // Same rule as the module's resolveInitialState + queryFor (the address, then the viewer's saved settings);
    // the module uses the response only when its own query is identical, so a mismatch costs one request, never
    // a wrong forecast. Not for ?render=full (the table is in the page).
    (function () {
      try {
        var p = new URLSearchParams(location.search), st = {}, swan = ["51201", "51202", "51203", "51204", "51205", "51206", "51207", "51208", "51210", "51211", "51212", "51213"];
        if (p.get('render') === 'full') return;
        try { var o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('allshore.settings.v1') || '{}'); if (o && typeof o === 'object') st = o; } catch (e) {}
        var unit = p.has('unit') ? p.get('unit') : (typeof st.unit === 'string' ? st.unit : 'US');
        var station = p.get('station') || '51201';
        var q = new URLSearchParams({
          station: station,
          tz: p.has('tz') ? p.get('tz') : (typeof st.tz === 'string' ? st.tz : ''),
          unit: unit === 'Metric' ? 'Metric' : 'US',
          model: (p.get('model') || 'GFS').toUpperCase() === 'SWAN' && swan.indexOf(station) >= 0 ? 'SWAN' : 'GFS',   // the loader's normalise()
          compact: '1'
        }).toString();
        var f = fetch('/api/forecast?' + q);
        f.catch(function () {});
        window.__early.forecast = { q: q, p: f };
      } catch (e) {}
    })();
    // ---- end early forecast ----
  </script>
  <!-- Open the CDN + tile-server connections while the HTML is still streaming (DNS+TLS is
       most of the cost of the first request on a cellular link). -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://unpkg.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://server.arcgisonline.com">
  <!-- Bootstrap -->
  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
  <!-- Leaflet CSS (the script is loaded just before the map code, below the page body) -->
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" />
  <script>document.documentElement.classList.add('js');</script>
  <style>
    html, body { height: 100%; }
    /* The map is the page (plan section 26): the script sets its height from the viewport (phone bars taken off). */
    html.js body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    #map { height: 100vh; height: 100dvh; background: #0b2536; }
    html:not(.js) #map { height: 320px; border: 1px solid #ccc; }
    .leaflet-tooltip { font-weight: 600; }
    .form-inline .form-select, .form-inline .form-control { width: auto; }

    /* smaller axis labels so 90° rotation stays readable */
    .chartjs-size-monitor, .chartjs-render-monitor { font-size: 10px; }
    /* ---------------- Live buoy panel (NDBC + worldwide sources) ---------------- */

    .live-buoy-marker {
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.9));
    }

    /* the live-buoy window's box (the shared window rules are .fwin below) */
    .fwin.live-win { right: 18px; bottom: 18px; width: min(820px, calc(100vw - 36px)); height: min(76vh, 720px); z-index: 2000; }   /* (.fwin's z is 1500) */
    .live-win .fw-body { padding: 12px 14px; }

    .live-buoy-summary {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .live-buoy-metric {
      border: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .live-buoy-metric .label {
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      color: #6c757d;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .live-buoy-metric .value {
      font-size: 1.28rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .component-card-wrap {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(185px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .component-card {
      border: 1px solid #dfe6ee;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: #fff;
      padding: 10px;
    }

    .component-card .component-title {
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .component-card .component-type {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: #6c757d;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .component-card .component-main {
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .component-card .component-detail {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: #495057;
    }

    .component-table td,
    .component-table th {
      white-space: nowrap;
      vertical-align: middle;
    }

    #liveSpectrumChart {
      max-height: 260px;
    }

    .component-meta {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }

    .component-badge {
      display: inline-block;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      background: #eef3f8;
      color: #2d3b48;
      border: 1px solid #d8e2ec;
    }

    .component-badge.high {
      background: #e8f6ee;
      color: #146c43;
      border-color: #b7e1c8;
    }

    .component-badge.medium {
      background: #fff8e6;
      color: #8a5a00;
      border-color: #ffe0a3;
    }

    .component-badge.low {
      background: #fff0f0;
      color: #9f2b2b;
      border-color: #f0b8b8;
    }

    .algorithm-note {
      background: #f8fbff;
      border: 1px solid #dfe9f5;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 700px) {
      .live-buoy-summary {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    /* Forecast/live buoy marker distinction */
    .live-buoy-div-icon {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
    }

    .live-buoy-dot {
      display: block;
      width: 11px;
      height: 11px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #00E5FF;
      border: 2px solid #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.9);
    }

    .forecast-buoy-dot {
      background: #FFD600;
    }

    /* Async forecast loading (Phase 2b) */
    .forecast-loading {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 1.25rem 0.5rem;
      color: #6c757d;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
    }
    .spinner {
      display: inline-block;
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      border: 3px solid #e0e6ee;
      border-top-color: #0d6efd;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    /* ===== Phase 3a: mobile + visual polish ===== */

    /* ---------------- The brand and the gear on the map (plan section 26) ----------------
       #pageHead holds them for the no-JS page; with JS they are adopted by map controls: the brand at the
       top-left above the model-overlay selector, the gear at the top-right under the layer legend. */
    .js #pageHead { display: none; }
    html:not(.js) #pageHead { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; }
    .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; text-decoration: none; flex: 0 0 auto; }
    /* the wordmark alone over the map: no box, border or padding (owner, plan section 27) */
    .brand .brand-logo { display: block; height: 60px; width: auto; }
    .leaflet-control-brand { margin: 8px 0 0 10px; background: none; border: 0; box-shadow: none; }
    .leaflet-control-brand .brand { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; box-shadow: none; line-height: 0; }
    .settings-host { position: relative; }
    /* the top-right corner (layer legend + gear) outranks the windows only while the gear's panel is open (so the
       panel is never covered); otherwise a window is always above the map's controls, so its own buttons can never
       land under them (owner). The maximised forecast window starts below that corner (--map-topright-h). */
    .leaflet-container.settings-open .leaflet-top.leaflet-right { z-index: 2600; }
    .icon-btn {
      width: 38px; height: 38px; border: 1px solid #ced4da; border-radius: .375rem; background: #fff;
      font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1; color: #0b2536; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .icon-btn[aria-expanded="true"] { background: #e7f1ff; border-color: #86b7fe; }
    .settings-panel {
      position: absolute; right: 0; top: calc(100% + 4px); width: 260px; padding: 10px 12px; text-align: left;
      background: #fff; border: 1px solid #ced4da; border-radius: .375rem;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.18); z-index: 2000;
    }
    .settings-panel .form-label { font-weight: 600; font-size: .85rem; }
    .grid-setting { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: .9rem; }
    html:not(.js) .grid-setting { display: none; }                              /* the gridlines need the map script */
    /* Map tools (plan section 29): the button beside the gear, its menu, the tool bar under the gear, the exposure fan */
    .leaflet-control-settings { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: flex-start; }
    /* the gear's panel and the tools menu drop over the tool bar (a later control at Leaflet's z 800): G20 P0 */
    .leaflet-top.leaflet-right .leaflet-control-settings { z-index: 801; }
    .tools-host { position: relative; }
    html:not(.js) .tools-host { display: none; }
    .icon-btn svg { display: block; margin: auto; }
    .tools-menu { width: 210px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
    .tools-menu[hidden] { display: none; }
    .tools-menu .tool-item { text-align: left; border: 1px solid #ced4da; border-radius: .375rem; background: #fff; padding: 6px 10px; font-size: .9rem; color: #0b2536; cursor: pointer; }
    .tools-menu .tool-item:hover, .tools-menu .tool-item[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #e7f1ff; border-color: #86b7fe; }
    /* the script caps the bar at the map's bottom edge; the actions stay under the title and the body scrolls */
    .tools-bar { width: 290px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #ced4da; border-radius: .375rem; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.18); padding: 8px 10px; font-size: .85rem; color: #0b2536; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .tools-bar[hidden] { display: none !important; }
    .tools-bar-head, .tools-bar-actions { flex: none; }
    .tools-bar-body { overflow-y: auto; min-height: 0; }
    .tools-bar-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
    .tools-head-btns { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; }
    .tools-x, .tools-fold { border: 0; background: none; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1; padding: 2px 4px; cursor: pointer; color: #0b2536; }
    .tools-bar-body .tools-big { font-weight: 600; margin-top: 4px; }
    .tools-bar-body .tools-sector { margin-top: 4px; min-height: 4.5em; white-space: pre-line; }   /* three lines: hovering does not resize the bar; larger text sizes grow it, never clip it (G21 B-5) */
    .tools-bar-actions button.is-on { background: #e7f1ff; border-color: #86b7fe; }
    .tools-bar-body .tools-hint { color: #5b6770; font-size: .78rem; margin-top: 4px; }
    .tools-bar-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 6px; }
    .tools-bar-actions[hidden] { display: none; }
    .tools-bar-actions button { border: 1px solid #ced4da; background: #fff; border-radius: .3rem; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: .8rem; color: #0b2536; }
    .tools-bar-actions button[hidden] { display: none; }
    .leaflet-container.tools-active, .leaflet-container.tools-active .leaflet-interactive { cursor: crosshair; }
    .tools-fan { background: none; border: 0; }
    .tools-fan svg { display: block; overflow: visible; }
    .tools-fan-label { font: 700 11px system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; fill: #fff; paint-order: stroke; stroke: rgba(0,0,0,.75); stroke-width: 3px; }
    .tools-label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; padding: 1px 5px; }
    .tools-ring-label { background: none; border: 0; pointer-events: none; }
    .tools-ring-label span { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); white-space: nowrap; font: 600 11px system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 0 3px #000, 0 0 2px #000; }
    /* lat/long gridline labels (static_ui/graticule.js): above the panes, below the map's controls */
    .graticule-labels { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 450; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; }
    .graticule-label {
      position: absolute; font: 600 11px/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: #fff; white-space: nowrap;
      text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.9), 0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
    }
    /* Colored dot next to each layer-control label (doubles as the legend) */
    .lc-dot {
      display: inline-block; width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%;
      margin: 0 6px 0 2px; vertical-align: middle; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    }
    .lc-forecast { background: #FFD600; }
    .lc-live { background: #00E5FF; }
    .lc-point { background: #fff; border: 2px solid #d6007a; }
    /* the live list's state beside "Live buoys" (static_ui/livelist.js): loading / cached list / loading more / retrying */
    .lc-note { margin-left: 5px; font-size: 11px; color: #6c757d; font-style: italic; }
    .lc-note:empty { display: none; }
    .my-pt { background: #fff; border: 2.5px solid #d6007a; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.45); cursor: pointer; }
    .my-pt.my-pt-unkept { background: transparent; border-style: dashed; }       /* the point on screen, not in My points */
    @media (pointer: coarse) { .my-pt::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -12px; } }   /* a finger-sized target (G22 B-20) */
    .leaflet-container.tools-active .my-pt { cursor: crosshair; }

    /* ---------------- The floating windows (plan sections 25, 26) ----------------
       .fwin = the shared rules (the forecast window and the live-buoy window); each has its own box. */
    .fwin {
      position: fixed;
      min-width: 360px; min-height: 180px; max-width: 100vw; max-height: 100vh;
      z-index: 1500; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
      background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.18); border-radius: 10px;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.32); overflow: hidden;
    }
    .fwin[hidden] { display: none !important; }
    .forecast-win { right: 16px; bottom: 16px; width: min(1180px, calc(100vw - 32px)); height: min(60vh, 720px); }
    /* a parked live chip sits on the default box's resize corner: the default box rises above it (a dragged window
       keeps its own inline position) */
    .live-chip .forecast-win:not(.fw-min):not(.fw-max) { bottom: 70px; }
    .fw-header {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 10px;
      background: #f3f7fb; border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e9f0; cursor: move; user-select: none; touch-action: none;
    }
    .fw-header:focus { outline: none; }
    .fw-titles { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; }
    .fw-titles strong { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    /* the favourites picker IS the forecast window's heading (expanded and minimised) */
    /* the picker box shrinks (its label gets the ellipsis) and never covers the run text beside it; the run text
       never shrinks (the chip grows to fit it, up to its max-width) */
    .fw-titles .station-field { flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 0; display: flex; }
    .fw-titles .station-field .station-picker { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }
    .fw-header .station-field { cursor: default; touch-action: auto; }
    .fw-header .station-trigger { width: auto; max-width: 100%; }
    .fw-header .station-trigger .station-current { max-width: 48ch; }
    .fw-titles .fw-cycle { color: #5a6b7a; font-size: .85rem; flex: 0 0 auto; }
    /* a label "name — coordinates": the name is cut when room runs out, never the coordinates (G22 B-4) */
    .lbl-split { display: flex; min-width: 0; }
    .lbl-split .lbl-name { flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .lbl-split .lbl-coord { flex: 0 0 auto; white-space: nowrap; }
    .fw-note { background: #eef4fb; border: 1px solid #c9daf0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: .9rem; }
    .fw-btn {
      width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 1px solid #ced4da; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff;
      line-height: 1; font-size: 1rem; color: #0b2536; cursor: pointer; flex: 0 0 auto;
    }
    .fw-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .fw-body { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; padding: 8px 10px; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; container-type: inline-size; container-name: fwbody; }
    /* The forecast window's body has no top or side padding: the frozen header and the sticky Date / Time columns sit
       at offset 0 (Chromium paints a sticky table header at a negative offset short of the scroll box's padding: the
       scrolled rows showed through a few pixels above it). The spacing goes to the parts around the table. */
    .forecast-win .fw-body { padding: 0 0 8px; }
    .forecast-win .fw-body > #fwNote, .forecast-win .fw-body > #fwError, .forecast-win .fw-body > #forecastMeta,
    .forecast-win .fw-body > #forecastSummary, .forecast-win .fw-body > #graphs { margin-left: 10px; margin-right: 10px; }
    .forecast-win .fw-body > #fwNote, .forecast-win .fw-body > #fwError { margin-top: 8px; }
    .forecast-win #forecastMeta { padding-top: 8px; }
    #forecastTable > .text-muted { padding: 8px 10px; }
    .fw-meta { color: #5a6b7a; font-size: .85rem; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .fw-resize:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d6fd6; outline-offset: -2px; }
    /* the window touched last is on top: the forecast window over the live-buoy window (z 2000) once touched */
    .forecast-win.fw-front { z-index: 2100; }
    /* stretch from every side (plan section 27): invisible 5 px edges and 10 px corners inside the border; the body
       keeps a 5 px margin so its scrollbars are never under an edge; the top edge sits in the header's 6 px padding */
    .fw-edge { position: absolute; z-index: 5; touch-action: none; }
    .fw-edge-n { top: 0; left: 10px; right: 10px; height: 5px; cursor: ns-resize; }
    .fw-edge-s { bottom: 0; left: 10px; right: 18px; height: 5px; cursor: ns-resize; }
    .fw-edge-e { right: 0; top: 10px; bottom: 18px; width: 5px; cursor: ew-resize; }
    .fw-edge-w { left: 0; top: 10px; bottom: 10px; width: 5px; cursor: ew-resize; }
    .fw-edge-ne { top: 0; right: 0; width: 10px; height: 10px; cursor: nesw-resize; }
    .fw-edge-nw { top: 0; left: 0; width: 10px; height: 10px; cursor: nwse-resize; }
    .fw-edge-sw { bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 10px; height: 10px; cursor: nesw-resize; }
    @media (min-width: 501px) and (min-height: 501px) { .fwin:not(.fw-min) .fw-body { margin: 0 5px 5px; } }   /* kept when maximised */
    .fw-resize {
      position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 18px; height: 18px; cursor: nwse-resize; touch-action: none; z-index: 6;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 50%, #b0bac4 50%, #b0bac4 60%, transparent 60%, transparent 75%, #b0bac4 75%);
    }
    /* minimised: the header bar alone; on desktops the forecast chip is parked at the bottom-left beside the
       Home button and the live-buoy chip at the bottom-right; each takes at most half the width, so they never meet */
    .fwin.fw-min { height: auto !important; min-height: 0; min-width: 0; }   /* a chip shrinks below the window minimum (the chips never meet) */
    @media (min-width: 501px) and (min-height: 501px) {
      .forecast-win.fw-min {
        left: 60px !important; right: auto !important; top: auto !important; bottom: 12px !important;

      }

    /* the compact table inside the window: the body is the scroll box, the header stays frozen. The table is as wide
       as its window (its nowrap cells keep it at least its natural width: the body scrolls sideways below that) and
       its text grows a little in a wide window (plan section 35). */
    #forecastTable { overflow: visible; }
    #forecastTable table { margin-bottom: 0; }
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact { font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.25; width: 100%; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact td, #forecastTable table.forecast-compact th { padding: 2px 5px; white-space: nowrap; }
    @container fwbody (min-width: 1500px) {
      #forecastTable table.forecast-compact { font-size: 13.5px; }
      #forecastTable table.forecast-compact td, #forecastTable table.forecast-compact th { padding: 3px 6px; }
    }
    #forecastTable thead { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 2; }
    #forecastTable thead th,
    #forecastTable thead td { background-color: #fff; }  /* opaque default; colored headers keep their inline bg */
    /* the coloured group headers, softened a little (the server keeps its inline colours) */
    #forecastTable thead tr:first-child th[style] { background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.15), rgba(255,255,255,.15)); }
    .forecast-info { text-align: left; font-weight: 700; }
    /* The real sky (plan section 35): the server classes each row sky-day (any part of it between first light and last
       light) or sky-night. Daylight rows are bold with solid black borders, night rows normal with dashed grey ones (the
       look the fixed 6 AM - 7 PM rule had; owner), and a slate-blue tint is laid over each night cell's own swell colour
       as a background image, so the colours stay. The borders are SEPARATE, each cell drawing its top and left edge, the
       frozen Time column and the right-edge cells (col-last) their right edge and the last row its bottom, all in their
       row's style: Chromium paints a frozen cell's collapsed borders where the cell would have been, which left slivers
       of the scrolled rows beside the frozen Date / Time columns and under the frozen header. */
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact { border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; }
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact th, #forecastTable table.forecast-compact td { border: 0 solid #dee2e6; border-top-width: 1px; border-left-width: 1px; }
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact .col-time, #forecastTable table.forecast-compact .col-last { border-right-width: 1px; }
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact tbody > tr:last-child > td { border-bottom-width: 1px; }
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact .col-time + *, #forecastTable table.forecast-compact thead > tr:nth-child(2) > :first-child { border-left-width: 0; }
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact thead > tr:last-child > *, #forecastTable table.forecast-compact thead > tr:first-child > [rowspan] { border-bottom-width: 1px; }
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact tbody td { background-image: linear-gradient(var(--tint, transparent), var(--tint, transparent)); }
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact tr.sky-day > td { font-weight: 700; border-color: #000; }
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact tr.sky-night > td { border-color: #999; border-style: dashed; }
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact :where(tr.sky-day) + tr.sky-night > td { border-top-style: solid; border-top-color: #000; }   /* the line under a day row stays solid, as collapsed borders drew it */
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact tr.day-first > td { border-top: 2px solid #8a949e; }
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact tbody > tr:first-child > td { border-top-width: 0; }                          /* the frozen header draws that line */
    #forecastTable tr.sky-night { --tint: rgba(30,70,140,.10); }
    #forecastTable tbody tr:hover { --tint: rgba(0,0,0,.08); }
    #forecastTable tbody tr.sky-night:hover { --tint: rgba(30,70,140,.22); }
    #forecastTable tr.now-row { --tint: rgba(29,111,214,.14); }
    #forecastTable tr.now-row td.col-date { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #1d6fd6; }
    #forecastTable td.col-sun { font-size: .92em; line-height: 1.2; color: #334; }
    #forecastTable .sun-ev.ev-dawn, #forecastTable .sun-ev.ev-dusk { color: #6f5816; }          /* >= 4.6:1 on every row tint (WCAG AA) */
    #forecastTable .sun-ev.ev-sunrise, #forecastTable .sun-ev.ev-sunset { color: #934207; }
    #forecastTable .sun-ev.ev-moonrise, #forecastTable .sun-ev.ev-moonset { color: #3b4d7a; }
    #forecastTable .moon-phase { color: #3b4d7a; white-space: nowrap; }
    /* Date and Time stay put while the body scrolls sideways (the Time column's offset is the Date column's rendered
       width, --date-w, measured by the script); the frozen header's corner cells sit above both */
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact td.col-date, #forecastTable table.forecast-compact td.col-time { position: sticky; z-index: 1; background-color: #fff; }
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact td.col-date, #forecastTable thead th.col-date { left: 0; }
    #forecastTable table.forecast-compact td.col-time, #forecastTable thead th.col-time { left: var(--date-w, 0px); }
    #forecastTable thead th.col-date, #forecastTable thead th.col-time { position: sticky; z-index: 3; }
    .dir-arrow { display: inline-block; width: 1em; margin-left: .15em; line-height: 1; font-size: .95em; color: #333; }
    /* the Summary view: one row a day */
    .forecast-summary table { width: 100%; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.3; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin-bottom: 0; }
    .forecast-summary td, .forecast-summary th { white-space: nowrap; padding: 4px 8px; vertical-align: middle; }
    .forecast-summary thead th { background: #f3f7fb; }

    .forecast-summary .trend-rising { color: #1a7f37; } .forecast-summary .trend-falling { color: #934207; } .forecast-summary .trend-peak { color: #1a66c6; }
    .forecast-summary .sum-sun { color: #934207; } .forecast-summary .sum-moon { color: #3b4d7a; }
    .forecast-summary tbody tr:hover td { background-color: rgba(0,0,0,.04); }
    @container fwbody (min-width: 1500px) { .forecast-summary table { font-size: 13.5px; } }
    #graphs .chart-box { position: relative; height: 260px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    #graphs .chart-box:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
    /* no JS: the forecast window is a plain card in the page flow (render=full); the live window needs JS */
    html:not(.js) .forecast-win { position: static !important; width: auto !important; max-width: none; height: auto !important; box-shadow: none; margin-top: 12px; }
    html:not(.js) .forecast-win.fw-min .fw-toolbar, html:not(.js) .forecast-win.fw-min .fw-body { display: block; }

    .home-control { position: relative; }

    @media (max-width: 500px), (max-height: 500px) {

      .fwin:not(.fw-min) { z-index: 3500; }

      .fw-resize, .fw-edge { display: none; }

<body class="bg-light">

  <!-- The brand and the settings gear (plan section 26): a plain row without JS; with JS the map script adopts
       them into map controls (the brand top-left above the model-overlay selector, the gear top-right under the
       layer legend) and the map fills the page. The form is the no-JS fallback (its Go button only shows without
       JS; the station select in the forecast window and the view / model selects point at it with form="controlForm"). -->
  <div id="pageHead">

      <img class="brand-logo" src="/ui/logo.png?v=1.17.0" alt="Allshore Surf" width="194" height="60">
    </a>
    <!-- Map tools (plan sections 29, 31; static_ui/tools.js): forecast point, measure distance / area, swell exposure. JS only; the map

    </div>
    <form id="controlForm" method="GET" action="/">

  <div id="map"></div>

    <!-- The forecast window (plan section 25): floating, draggable, resizable; minimised on load. Its heading is

  <!-- The live-buoy window (NDBC rich panel + adaptive panel for other sources): a floating window like the

  <section id="liveBuoyPanel" class="fwin live-win" hidden role="region" aria-label="Live buoy">

      <!-- Adaptive bulk panel for non-NDBC live buoys (CDIP / AODN / QLD / AusWaves) -->
