  <script>
    // ---- Preserve map zoom/center between requests ----
    const mapKey = 'mapView';
    const layerVisibilityKey = 'mapLayerVisibility';
    let liveWin = null;                         // the live-buoy floating window (static_ui/forecast.js), set by the last script

    // Web Mercator practical latitude limits.
    // Longitude is intentionally not bounded so the map can scroll continuously east/west.
    // The farthest the map shows: just past Greenland's northern tip (Cape Morris Jesup, 83.6 N) and just
    // past Antarctica's ice-shelf fronts (Ross / Ronne, about 78.5 S); Mercator stretches the last degrees
    // enormously, so the old 85 left a void the height of a continent south of Antarctica.
    const LAT_LIMIT_NORTH = 84;
    const LAT_LIMIT_SOUTH = -79;
    function clampLat(lat) { return Math.max(LAT_LIMIT_SOUTH, Math.min(LAT_LIMIT_NORTH, lat)); }

    const DEFAULT_MAP_CENTER = [21.3, -157.9];
    const DEFAULT_MAP_ZOOM = 6;

    // ---- Home View (Phase 3b): the user's saved default map focus ----
    const homeViewKey = 'allshore.mapHome.v1';
    const HOME_PRESETS = {
      Hawaii:     { lat: 21.3, lng: -157.9, z: 6 },
      California: { lat: 36.0, lng: -122.0, z: 6 },
      Florida:    { lat: 27.5, lng: -80.0,  z: 6 },
      Europe:     { lat: 46.0, lng: -8.0,   z: 5 },
    };
    function loadHomeView() {
      try {
        const v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(homeViewKey));
        if (v && Number.isFinite(v.lat) && Number.isFinite(v.lng) && Number.isFinite(v.z)) return v;
      } catch (e) {}
      return null;
    }
    function saveHomeView(v) { try { localStorage.setItem(homeViewKey, JSON.stringify(v)); } catch (e) {} }
    function clearHomeView() { try { localStorage.removeItem(homeViewKey); } catch (e) {} }
    function normLng(lng) { return ((lng + 540) % 360) - 180; }
    // Explicit Home actions also align the in-session view (sessionStorage has
    // higher precedence), so the choice persists within the tab AND on reload.
    function writeSessionView(v) { try { sessionStorage.setItem(mapKey, JSON.stringify(v)); } catch (e) {} }
    function clearSessionView() { try { sessionStorage.removeItem(mapKey); } catch (e) {} }

    // Approximately 3 zoom levels closer than the earlier maxZoom of 8.
    const MAX_MAP_ZOOM = 11;

    // Leaflet world width is 256 px at zoom 0.
    // MIN_MAP_ZOOM is calculated after the map container size is known so that
    // the fully zoomed-out map shows no more than one repeated world.
    const WORLD_TILE_SIZE = 256;
    const MIN_ZOOM_PADDING_PX = 2;
    let MIN_MAP_ZOOM = 1;

    function loadLayerVisibility() {
      try {
        const saved = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(layerVisibilityKey));

        if (saved && typeof saved === 'object') {
          return {
            forecast: saved.forecast !== false,
            live: saved.live !== false,
            points: saved.points !== false
          };
        }
      } catch(e) {}

      return { forecast: true, live: true, points: true };
    }

    function saveLayerVisibility() {
      sessionStorage.setItem(
        layerVisibilityKey,
        JSON.stringify({
          forecast: map.hasLayer(forecastLayer),
          live: map.hasLayer(liveBuoyLayer),
          points: map.hasLayer(pointLayer)
        })
      );
    }

    function saveMapView(map) {
      const v = { c: map.getCenter(), z: map.getZoom() };

      const safeLat = clampLat(v.c.lat);

      sessionStorage.setItem(
        mapKey,
        JSON.stringify({
          lat: safeLat,
          lng: v.c.lng,
          z: Math.min(MAX_MAP_ZOOM, Math.max(v.z, MIN_MAP_ZOOM || 1))
        })
      );
    }

    function loadMapView() {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(mapKey));
      } catch(e) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    // ---- Leaflet Map ----
    // No maxBounds here. Latitude is clamped manually; longitude wraps continuously.
    const map = L.map('map', {
      // Canvas renderer: draws all forecast circle markers onto one canvas
      // instead of thousands of individual SVG <path> nodes, which sharply
      // reduces layout/repaint overhead during pan/zoom.
      preferCanvas: true,
      worldCopyJump: false,
      zoomControl: false,                    // the keys, the wheel and pinching zoom (plan section 24)
      minZoom: 1,
      maxZoom: MAX_MAP_ZOOM,

      // Fractional zoom lets the minimum zoom match the viewport width,
      // preventing multiple world copies at the fully zoomed-out extent.
      zoomSnap: 0.1,
      zoomDelta: 0.5,
      wheelPxPerZoomLevel: 80
    });
    // The credits stay (Esri's terms, the overlay's NOAA / GSHHG line); the "Leaflet" prefix goes (plan section 26).
    if (map.attributionControl) map.attributionControl.setPrefix(false);

    // The brand on the map, top-left, added first so it sits above the model-overlay selector (plan section 26).
    const BrandControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: 'topleft' },
      onAdd: function () {
        const c = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-control-brand');
        const brand = document.getElementById('brand');
        if (brand) c.appendChild(brand);
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(c);
        return c;
      }
    });
    map.addControl(new BrandControl());

    const initialLayerVisibility = loadLayerVisibility();
    const forecastLayer = L.layerGroup();
    const liveBuoyLayer = L.layerGroup();
    // The visitor's own forecast points (plan section 31): white rings in the marker pane, above the forecast dots.
    const pointLayer = L.layerGroup();
    const pointIcon = L.divIcon({ className: 'my-pt', iconSize: [14, 14], iconAnchor: [7, 7] });
    const pointIconUnkept = L.divIcon({ className: 'my-pt my-pt-unkept', iconSize: [14, 14], iconAnchor: [7, 7] });
    // A tooltip with the visitor's or a provider's words: as TEXT (Leaflet puts a string in as HTML: G22 K-8, A-20)
    function textTip(t) { const el = document.createElement('span'); el.textContent = String(t == null ? '' : t); return el; }
    if (initialLayerVisibility.points) pointLayer.addTo(map);

    if (initialLayerVisibility.forecast) {
      forecastLayer.addTo(map);
    }

    if (initialLayerVisibility.live) {
      liveBuoyLayer.addTo(map);
    }

    const layersControl = L.control.layers(
      null,
      {
        // Leaflet renders layer names as HTML, so the colored dot doubles as
        // the legend (yellow = forecast point, cyan = live NDBC buoy). The empty
        // .lc-note carries the live list's state (paintLiveNote, below).
        '<span class="lc-dot lc-forecast"></span>Forecast points': forecastLayer,
        '<span class="lc-dot lc-live"></span>Live buoys<span class="lc-note" data-live-note aria-live="polite"></span>': liveBuoyLayer,
        '<span class="lc-dot lc-point"></span>My points': pointLayer
      },
      {
        collapsed: false
      }
    ).addTo(map);
    // The live list's state beside its legend entry, as TEXT. Leaflet rebuilds the list's DOM whenever a layer of
    // the control is added or removed by code, so the text is kept here and painted again after every rebuild.
    let liveNoteText = '';
    function paintLiveNote() {
      const el = document.querySelector('.leaflet-control-layers [data-live-note]');
      if (el && el.textContent !== liveNoteText) el.textContent = liveNoteText;
    }
    if (typeof layersControl._update === 'function') {
      const lcUpdate = layersControl._update;
      layersControl._update = function () { const r = lcUpdate.apply(this, arguments); paintLiveNote(); return r; };
    }

    map.on('overlayadd', saveLayerVisibility);
    map.on('overlayremove', saveLayerVisibility);

    // The settings gear under the layer legend (top-right); its panel (Time Zone, Units, gridlines) opens below it.
    const SettingsControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: 'topright' },
      onAdd: function () {
        const c = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-control-settings');
        const tools = document.getElementById('toolsHost'), host = document.getElementById('settingsHost');
        if (tools) c.appendChild(tools);                                        // the map tools button sits left of the gear (plan section 29)
        if (host) c.appendChild(host);
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(c);
        L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(c);
        return c;
      }
    });
    map.addControl(new SettingsControl());
    // While the gear's panel is open the corner outranks the windows (CSS .settings-open); the module toggles the
    // panel's hidden attribute, so an observer follows it.
    (function () {
      const panel = document.getElementById('settingsPanel'), tmenu = document.getElementById('toolsMenu');
      if (!panel || typeof MutationObserver !== 'function') return;
      const sync = () => map.getContainer().classList.toggle('settings-open', !panel.hidden || !!(tmenu && !tmenu.hidden));
      new MutationObserver(sync).observe(panel, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['hidden'] });
      if (tmenu) new MutationObserver(sync).observe(tmenu, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['hidden'] });
      sync();
    })();
    // The height of that corner (legend + gear): the maximised forecast window starts below it, so its header buttons
    // never land under the legend (owner). Measured at load and on every resize (enforceSingleWorld).
    function measureTopRight() {
      const box = map.getContainer(), base = box.getBoundingClientRect();
      let h = 0;
      box.querySelectorAll('.leaflet-top.leaflet-right .leaflet-control').forEach(function (c) {
        const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.height > 0) h = Math.max(h, r.bottom - base.top);
      });
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--map-topright-h', Math.round(h) + 'px');
    }

    // Esri imagery.
    // noWrap:false allows horizontal world wrapping, which prevents grey side areas
    // when panning east/west across the dateline.
    L.tileLayer(
      'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',
      {
        maxZoom: MAX_MAP_ZOOM,
        minZoom: 1,
        noWrap: false,
        keepBuffer: 2,
        attribution: '© Esri & contributors'
      }
    ).addTo(map);

    // --- Home View control: set/jump/reset the default map focus ---
    const HomeControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: 'bottomleft' },
      onAdd: function () {
        const container = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar home-control');
        const btn = L.DomUtil.create('a', 'home-btn', container);
        btn.href = '#';
        btn.title = 'Home view';
        btn.setAttribute('role', 'button');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Home view menu');
        btn.innerHTML = '⌂';
        const menu = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'home-menu', container);
        menu.style.display = 'none';
        menu.innerHTML =
          '<div class="home-menu-title">Home view</div>' +
          '<button type="button" data-home="set">Set current view as home</button>' +
          '<button type="button" data-preset="Hawaii">Hawaii</button>' +
          '<button type="button" data-preset="California">California</button>' +
          '<button type="button" data-preset="Florida">Florida</button>' +
          '<button type="button" data-preset="Europe">Europe</button>' +
          '<button type="button" data-home="reset">Reset to default</button>';
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(container);
        L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(container);
        L.DomEvent.on(btn, 'click', function (e) {
          L.DomEvent.preventDefault(e);
          menu.style.display = (menu.style.display === 'none') ? 'block' : 'none';
        });
        L.DomEvent.on(menu, 'click', function (e) {
          const t = e.target.closest('button');
          if (!t) return;
          L.DomEvent.preventDefault(e);
          if (t.dataset.preset && HOME_PRESETS[t.dataset.preset]) {
            const p = HOME_PRESETS[t.dataset.preset];
            saveHomeView(p); writeSessionView(p);
            map.setView([p.lat, p.lng], Math.min(MAX_MAP_ZOOM, Math.max(p.z, MIN_MAP_ZOOM)), { animate: true });
          } else if (t.dataset.home === 'set') {
            const c = map.getCenter();
            const v = { lat: c.lat, lng: normLng(c.lng), z: map.getZoom() };
            saveHomeView(v); writeSessionView(v);
          } else if (t.dataset.home === 'reset') {
            clearHomeView(); clearSessionView();
            map.setView(DEFAULT_MAP_CENTER, Math.max(DEFAULT_MAP_ZOOM, MIN_MAP_ZOOM), { animate: true });
          }
          menu.style.display = 'none';
        });
        return container;
      }
    });
    map.addControl(new HomeControl());

    // The map credits behind an (i) beside Home (bottom-left): Leaflet's attribution control moves to that corner
    // and shows only while the (i) is open (the overlay adds and removes its own line through the control).
    const AttrToggle = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: 'bottomleft' },
      onAdd: function (m) {
        const c = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar attr-toggle');
        const a = L.DomUtil.create('a', 'attr-btn', c);
        a.href = '#'; a.title = 'Map credits'; a.textContent = 'i';
        a.setAttribute('role', 'button'); a.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Map credits'); a.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(c);
        L.DomEvent.on(a, 'click', function (e) {
          L.DomEvent.preventDefault(e);
          const on = m.getContainer().classList.toggle('attr-open');
          a.setAttribute('aria-expanded', on ? 'true' : 'false');
        });
        return c;
      }
    });
    map.addControl(new AttrToggle());
    if (map.attributionControl) map.attributionControl.setPosition('bottomleft');
    // Dismiss the Home menu when interacting with the map (outside-click UX).
    map.on('movestart click', function () {
      document.querySelectorAll('.home-menu').forEach(function (m) { m.style.display = 'none'; });
    });

    // --- Stable map sizing, single-world zoom floor, and continuous east/west wrap ---
    // ---- map extent (tests/ui/mapclamp.test.js runs this block: keep it self-contained between the markers) ----
    function calculateSingleWorldMinZoom() {
      const el = document.getElementById('map');
      const size = map.getSize();
      const mapWidth = size.x || el.clientWidth || 1024;
      const mapHeight = size.y || el.clientHeight || 0;

      // At zoom 0 the world is 256 px wide. Require the world pixel width to be
      // at least the viewport width so no second world is visible at minimum zoom...
      const byWidth = Math.log2((mapWidth + MIN_ZOOM_PADDING_PX) / WORLD_TILE_SIZE);
      // ...and the band between the latitude limits (the poles) at least the viewport height, so the
      // poles are the farthest the map ever shows: a map taller than it is wide (a phone, a narrow
      // window) would otherwise show the void beyond both poles at once, which no clamp can cure.
      const bandAtZoom0 = map.project([LAT_LIMIT_SOUTH, 0], 0).y - map.project([LAT_LIMIT_NORTH, 0], 0).y;
      const byHeight = mapHeight ? Math.log2((mapHeight + MIN_ZOOM_PADDING_PX) / bandAtZoom0) : 0;
      return Math.max(byWidth, byHeight);
    }

    // Prevent north/south dragging into the void beyond the poles, while still allowing continuous
    // east/west movement. The overshoot is measured in PIXELS at the current zoom and the view is panned
    // back by whole pixels only: Leaflet truncates pan offsets to whole pixels, so a correction in degrees
    // that came to less than a pixel moved nothing, fired moveend again and recursed until the stack
    // overflowed (with a saved view near a pole the page died at load: every layer waiting for the map's
    // 'load' event, the station picker and the live buoys never came; a pan past a pole left the particle
    // animation suspended). The moveend of the clamp's own pan is ignored; the outer handler finishes once.
    let clampingLatitude = false;
    function latitudeOvershootPx() {
      const size = map.getSize(), zoom = map.getZoom();
      const top = map.project([LAT_LIMIT_NORTH, 0], zoom).y;        // world pixel y of the north limit
      const bottom = map.project([LAT_LIMIT_SOUTH, 0], zoom).y;     // ... and of the south limit
      const cy = map.project(map.getCenter(), zoom).y, half = size.y / 2;
      if (bottom - top <= size.y) return (top + bottom) / 2 - cy;   // the whole band fits: centre it (the min zoom prevents this)
      if (cy - half < top) return top - (cy - half);
      if (cy + half > bottom) return bottom - (cy + half);
      return 0;
    }
    function clampMapLatitude() {
      // an animation in flight ends with its own moveend: clamp then, from the settled view
      if (clampingLatitude || !map._loaded || map._animatingZoom || (map._panAnim && map._panAnim._inProgress)) return;
      const dy = Math.round(latitudeOvershootPx());
      if (!dy) return;
      clampingLatitude = true;
      try { map.panBy([0, dy], { animate: false }); } finally { clampingLatitude = false; }
    }

    function handleMapMoveEnd() {
      if (clampingLatitude) return;             // the clamp's own pan: the outer call finishes below
      try { clampMapLatitude(); } catch (e) { console.error('latitude clamp', e); }   // the map's load sequence must survive this handler
      refreshWrappedMarkerCopies(false);
      try { saveMapView(map); } catch (e) {}   // the page no longer reloads on a pick: keep the view for a real reload (storage may be blocked)
    }
    // ---- end map extent ----

    let lastEnforcedWidth = null, phoneBarH = 48;
    function enforceSingleWorld() {
      const el = document.getElementById('map');

      // The map is the page (plan section 26); in phone mode each minimised window is a bar along the bottom
      // edge (the forecast bar always: its height is measured while it is a bar and kept while it is expanded,
      // so the map never jumps; the live-buoy bar while one is parked) and the map stops above them.
      const w = window.innerWidth, phone = w <= 500 || window.innerHeight <= 500;
      const fwEl = document.getElementById('forecastWin'), lw = document.getElementById('liveBuoyPanel');
      if (fwEl && fwEl.classList.contains('fw-min') && fwEl.offsetHeight > 0) phoneBarH = fwEl.offsetHeight;
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--fw-bar-h', phoneBarH + 'px');
      const liveBar = lw && !lw.hidden && lw.classList.contains('fw-min') ? lw.offsetHeight : 0;
      const reserve = phone ? phoneBarH + liveBar : 0;
      const targetH = Math.max(phone ? 180 : 280, window.innerHeight - reserve);
      el.style.height = targetH + 'px';
      measureTopRight();

      // Leaflet measured the container at its CSS height when the map was created and ignores
      // invalidateSize() until the first view is set: force a fresh measurement (the map is much
      // taller than the 460 px CSS default now; a stale size left the lower part without tiles).
      map._sizeChanged = true;
      map.invalidateSize({ animate: false });

      // Maximum zoomed-out extent = one non-repeated world width.
      MIN_MAP_ZOOM = Math.max(1, calculateSingleWorldMinZoom());
      map.setMinZoom(MIN_MAP_ZOOM);

      // The stored view is (re)applied at load and when the width changes; a height-only resize (a phone's
      // browser bar collapsing, a soft keyboard for the settings) must not snap the map back.
      if (lastEnforcedWidth === w) { clampMapLatitude(); refreshWrappedMarkerCopies(true); return; }
      lastEnforcedWidth = w;

      // Precedence: in-session view (sessionStorage) > saved Home View
      // (localStorage) > hard default. Lets each user open to their region.
      const saved = loadMapView && loadMapView();
      const validSaved =
        saved && Number.isFinite(saved.lat) && Number.isFinite(saved.lng) && Number.isFinite(saved.z);
      const view = validSaved ? saved : loadHomeView();

      if (view) {
        const safeZoom = Math.min(MAX_MAP_ZOOM, Math.max(view.z, MIN_MAP_ZOOM));
        const safeLat = clampLat(view.lat);
        map.setView([safeLat, view.lng], safeZoom, { animate: false });
      } else {
        map.setView(
          DEFAULT_MAP_CENTER,
          Math.max(DEFAULT_MAP_ZOOM, MIN_MAP_ZOOM),
          { animate: false }
        );
      }
      map.invalidateSize({ animate: false });      // now that the map has a view, the size is really re-read

      clampMapLatitude();
      refreshWrappedMarkerCopies(true);
    }

    // Map movement, resize handling, and initial view are wired up after
    // wrapped marker helpers are defined. This avoids calling marker-copy
    // functions before their state variables are initialized.

    // ---------------- Wrapped marker handling ----------------
    // Leaflet tiles wrap horizontally, but markers do not. These helpers rebuild
    // marker copies around the currently viewed world so forecast and live buoys
    // remain visible while scrolling continuously east/west.

    let forecastStationsData = [];
    let liveStationsData = [];
    let markerWorldOffset = 0;

    function currentWorldOffset() {
      return Math.round(map.getCenter().lng / 360) * 360;
    }

    // Viewport-aware rendering. The full global station list stays in memory;
    // we only draw the wrapped marker copies whose position lands inside a
    // padded view box. Panning/zooming to any region reveals that region's
    // points on demand, so global access is fully preserved while we avoid
    // painting thousands of off-screen markers every frame.
    const VIEW_PAD = 0.25;            // over-render this fraction past the edges
    const REFRESH_DEBOUNCE_MS = 150;

    function visibleCopies(stations) {
      if (!stations || !stations.length) return [];

      const b = map.getBounds().pad(VIEW_PAD);
      const west = b.getWest(), east = b.getEast();
      const south = b.getSouth(), north = b.getNorth();
      const offset = currentWorldOffset();
      const offsets = [offset - 360, offset, offset + 360];
      const out = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < stations.length; i++) {
        const s = stations[i];
        const lat = Number(s.lat);
        if (!Number.isFinite(lat) || lat < south || lat > north) continue;
        const baseLon = Number(s.lon);
        if (!Number.isFinite(baseLon)) continue;

        for (let k = 0; k < offsets.length; k++) {
          const lng = baseLon + offsets[k];
          if (lng >= west && lng <= east) {
            out.push({ s: s, lng: lng, o: offsets[k] });
          }
        }
      }
      return out;
    }

    function renderSignature(copies) {
      // Stable key per visible marker copy (station id + world offset). If the
      // set is unchanged we skip the destroy/rebuild entirely.
      const keys = new Array(copies.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < copies.length; i++) {
        keys[i] = copies[i].s.id + '#' + copies[i].o;
      }
      keys.sort();
      return keys.join(',');
    }

    let lastForecastSig = null;
    let lastLiveSig = null;
    let refreshTimer = null;

    // `force` rebuilds immediately (init, resize, data load); otherwise the
    // request is debounced so rapid pan/zoom doesn't thrash the marker layers.
    function refreshWrappedMarkerCopies(force = false) {
      markerWorldOffset = currentWorldOffset();

      if (force) {
        if (refreshTimer) { clearTimeout(refreshTimer); refreshTimer = null; }
        rebuildForecastMarkers(true);
        rebuildLiveBuoyMarkers(true);
        rebuildPointMarkers(true);
        return;
      }

      if (refreshTimer) clearTimeout(refreshTimer);
      refreshTimer = setTimeout(function () {
        refreshTimer = null;
        rebuildForecastMarkers(false);
        rebuildLiveBuoyMarkers(false);
        rebuildPointMarkers(false);
      }, REFRESH_DEBOUNCE_MS);
    }

    function rebuildForecastMarkers(force = false) {
      const vis = visibleCopies(forecastStationsData);
      const sig = renderSignature(vis);
      if (!force && sig === lastForecastSig) return;
      lastForecastSig = sig;

      forecastLayer.clearLayers();

      vis.forEach(function (c) {
        const s = c.s;
        const mk = L.circleMarker([s.lat, c.lng], {
          radius: 3,
          color: '#FFD600',
          fillColor: '#FFD600',
          fillOpacity: 1,
          weight: 1
        }).addTo(forecastLayer);

        mk.bindTooltip(s.id, {
          permanent: false,
          direction: 'top',
          offset: [0, -2]
        });

        mk.on('click', function () {
          if (window.AllshoreTools && window.AllshoreTools.active()) return;   // a map tool takes the click (it reaches the map too)
          document.getElementById('station').value = s.id;
          saveLayerVisibility();
          // The forecast window loads the station in place (back to Buoy Local, as a pick always did).
          document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('allshore:station', { detail: { sid: String(s.id), source: 'map' } }));
        });
      });
    }

    // The visitor's points ([{id, lat, lon, label}], set by the page block after static_ui/forecast.js: setSavedPoints).
    let savedPointsData = [];
    let lastPointSig = null;
    function setSavedPoints(list) { savedPointsData = list || []; rebuildPointMarkers(true); }
    // a point was just added: its layer is shown even if the visitor had unticked it (G22 B-17)
    function showPointLayer() { if (!map.hasLayer(pointLayer)) { pointLayer.addTo(map); saveLayerVisibility(); } }
    function rebuildPointMarkers(force = false) {
      const vis = visibleCopies(savedPointsData);
      const sig = renderSignature(vis);
      if (!force && sig === lastPointSig) return;
      lastPointSig = sig;
      pointLayer.clearLayers();
      vis.forEach(function (c) {
        const p = c.s;
        const name = (p.kept === false ? 'Point on screen: ' : 'My point: ') + p.label;
        const mk = L.marker([p.lat, c.lng], { icon: p.kept === false ? pointIconUnkept : pointIcon, title: name, alt: name, riseOnHover: true }).addTo(pointLayer);
        mk.bindTooltip(textTip(p.label), { permanent: false, direction: 'top', offset: [0, -8] });
        mk.on('click', function (e) {
          if (window.AllshoreTools && window.AllshoreTools.active()) { window.AllshoreTools.click(e.latlng, e.originalEvent); return; }   // markers do not pass clicks to the map (G22 B-8)
          saveLayerVisibility();
          document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('allshore:station', { detail: { sid: String(p.id), source: 'map' } }));
        });
      });
    }

    // After a favorite is picked (which reloads the page via the form), recenter the
    // map on that buoy (a favourites pick; the picker asks through the 'allshore:station' event).
    const FORECAST_FOCUS_ZOOM = 8;
    let pendingFocusStation = null;
    function focusStation(sid) {
      const pt = window.AllshoreForecast && window.AllshoreForecast.parsePointId(sid);   // one of My points: where its id says
      if (pt) {
        map.setView([clampLat(pt.lat), normLng(pt.lon)], Math.min(MAX_MAP_ZOOM, Math.max(FORECAST_FOCUS_ZOOM, MIN_MAP_ZOOM)), { animate: true });
        clampMapLatitude(); refreshWrappedMarkerCopies(true); saveMapView(map);
        return;
      }
      if (!forecastStationsData.length) { pendingFocusStation = sid; return; }   // stations not loaded yet: after they are
      let st = null;
      for (let i = 0; i < forecastStationsData.length; i++) {
        if (String(forecastStationsData[i].id) === sid) { st = forecastStationsData[i]; break; }
      }
      if (!st) return;
      const lat = Number(st.lat), lon = Number(st.lon);
      if (!Number.isFinite(lat) || !Number.isFinite(lon)) return;
      const z = Math.min(MAX_MAP_ZOOM, Math.max(FORECAST_FOCUS_ZOOM, MIN_MAP_ZOOM));
      const safeLat = clampLat(lat);
      map.setView([safeLat, normLng(lon)], z, { animate: true });
      clampMapLatitude();
      refreshWrappedMarkerCopies(true);
      saveMapView(map);   // persist so subsequent reloads stay on the buoy
    }

    // Take the request started in <head> (once); any later call fetches afresh, so retries work.
    function earlyFetch(name, url) {
      const early = window.__early && window.__early[name];
      if (window.__early) window.__early[name] = null;
      return early || fetch(url);
    }

    // Plot forecast stations
    earlyFetch('stations', '/stations.json')
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(stations => {
        forecastStationsData = stations || [];
        rebuildForecastMarkers(true);
        if (pendingFocusStation) { const sid = pendingFocusStation; pendingFocusStation = null; focusStation(sid); }
      });

    // With JS the page never submits the form (every change applies in place); a favourites pick asks
    // the map to recentre on the station.
    document.getElementById('controlForm').addEventListener('submit', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); });
    document.addEventListener('allshore:station', (e) => {
      const d = e.detail || {};
      if (d.source === 'picker' && d.sid) focusStation(String(d.sid));
    });

    // ---------------- Live buoy layer (NDBC + CDIP + AU + Europe, merged + deduped) ----------------

    let liveSpectrumChart = null;

    // Chart.js is loaded on demand (only the Graph view ships it up front). One in-flight
    // load is shared; a FAILED load clears the promise so the next caller retries.
    let chartJsPromise = null;
    function loadChartJs() {
      if (window.Chart) return Promise.resolve();
      if (chartJsPromise) return chartJsPromise;
      chartJsPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const s = document.createElement('script');
        s.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.2/dist/chart.umd.min.js';
        s.onload = () => resolve();
        s.onerror = () => { chartJsPromise = null; reject(new Error('Chart.js failed to load')); };
        document.head.appendChild(s);
      });
      return chartJsPromise;
    }
    let activeLiveBuoyId = null;
    // Monotonic id of the latest detail-panel request. Every loader captures it on entry
    // and stops (no DOM writes) once a newer request or a panel close has bumped it, so an
    // older buoy's response can never overwrite the buoy currently shown.
    let liveDetailSeq = 0;

    function closeLiveBuoyPanel() {
      liveDetailSeq++;                          // discard any in-flight detail work
      if (liveWin) liveWin.close(); else document.getElementById('liveBuoyPanel').hidden = true;
    }
    let lastNoaaWaveSummaryData = null;
    let lastLiveComponentData = null;
    // Set while the panel is showing "No Recent Reports" so a unit change re-renders
    // that state instead of falling back to the (empty) summary/component views.
    let lastNoRecentStation = null;
    let lastGenericBuoy = null;

    function getSelectedUnit() {
      return document.getElementById('unit')?.value || 'US';
    }

    function formatHeight(data, useMetric) {
      if (!data) return '—';
      return useMetric ? `${data.height_m} m` : `${data.height_ft} ft`;
    }

    function formatTotalHeight(data, useMetric) {
      return useMetric ? `${data.total_height_m} m` : `${data.total_height_ft} ft`;
    }

    // Friendly marker/panel label: strip the source namespace from the id
    // (e.g. "ndbc:46221" -> "46221") and prefer the station name for other sources.
    function buoyDisplayLabel(s) {
      const id = s.id || '';
      if (/^ndbc:/i.test(id)) return id.replace(/^ndbc:/i, '');
      return s.name || id.replace(/^[a-z]+:/i, '');
    }

    function compassPoint(deg) {
      const n = Number(deg);
      if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return '';
      const dirs = ['N', 'NNE', 'NE', 'ENE', 'E', 'ESE', 'SE', 'SSE',
                    'S', 'SSW', 'SW', 'WSW', 'W', 'WNW', 'NW', 'NNW'];
      return dirs[Math.round(((n % 360) + 360) % 360 / 22.5) % 16];
    }

    function showLiveBuoyPanelLoading(station) {
      const panel = document.getElementById('liveBuoyPanel');

      document.getElementById('liveBuoyTitle').textContent = buoyDisplayLabel(station);

      const srcName = station.source_name || station.source || 'Live buoy';
      document.getElementById('liveBuoySubtitle').textContent =
        `${srcName} | ${Number(station.lat).toFixed(3)}, ${Number(station.lon).toFixed(3)}`;

      document.getElementById('liveBuoyLoading').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('liveBuoyError').classList.add('d-none');
      document.getElementById('liveBuoyContent').classList.add('d-none');
      document.getElementById('liveBuoyGeneric').classList.add('d-none');
      document.getElementById('liveBuoyNoRecent').classList.add('d-none');

      if (liveWin) liveWin.open(); else panel.hidden = false;
    }

    // NDBC buoy with no observation inside the freshness window: show only the
    // "No Recent Reports" state -- never stale cards/table/spectra.
    function showLiveBuoyNoRecent(data, station) {
      data = data || {};

      document.getElementById('liveBuoyNoRecentTitle').textContent =
        data.title || buoyDisplayLabel(station || {}) || '';

      const maxAge = data.max_age_hours || 24;

      document.getElementById('liveBuoyContent').classList.add('d-none');

    function showLiveBuoyError(message) {
      document.getElementById('liveBuoyLoading').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('liveBuoyContent').classList.add('d-none');
      document.getElementById('liveBuoyNoRecent').classList.add('d-none');

      const errorBox = document.getElementById('liveBuoyError');
      errorBox.textContent = message;
      errorBox.classList.remove('d-none');

    function componentTypeLabel(type) {
      if (!type) return '';
      return type === 'wind sea' ? 'Wind Sea' : 'Swell';
    }

    function formatWholePeriod(value) {
      const n = Number(value);

      if (!Number.isFinite(n)) {
        return '—';
      }

      return Math.round(n).toString();
    }

    function formatComponentPeriodValue(value) {
      const n = Number(value);

      if (!Number.isFinite(n)) {
        return '—';
      }

      // Keep actual spectrum bin values, but avoid unnecessary trailing zeros.
      const rounded = Math.round(n * 10) / 10;

      if (Math.abs(rounded - Math.round(rounded)) < 0.05) {
        return Math.round(rounded).toString();
      }

      return rounded.toFixed(1);
    }

    function periodFromFrequencyHz(freq) {
      const f = Number(freq);

      if (!Number.isFinite(f) || f <= 0) {
        return null;
      }

      return 1 / f;
    }

    function componentPeriodRange(c, spectrum) {
      const fMin = Number(c.frequency_min_hz);
      const fMax = Number(c.frequency_max_hz);

      if (!Number.isFinite(fMin) || !Number.isFinite(fMax) || fMin <= 0 || fMax <= 0) {
        return '—';
      }

      const lowFreq = Math.min(fMin, fMax);
      const highFreq = Math.max(fMin, fMax);
      const tolerance = 0.0008;

      // Use only actual spectrum bins inside the component frequency range.
      const binsInComponent = (spectrum || [])
        .filter(p => {
          const f = Number(p.frequency_hz);
          const e = Number(p.density_m2_per_hz);
          return (
            Number.isFinite(f) &&
            Number.isFinite(e) &&
            f >= (lowFreq - tolerance) &&
            f <= (highFreq + tolerance)
          );
        });

      if (!binsInComponent.length) {
        return '—';
      }

      const maxDensity = Math.max(...binsInComponent.map(p => Number(p.density_m2_per_hz)));

      if (!Number.isFinite(maxDensity) || maxDensity <= 0) {
        return '—';
      }

      // Trim near-zero tails. NDBC spectral files often contain tiny nonzero values
      // at very long/short periods that are not meaningful for a component range.
      // The displayed range should cover bins with real detectable energy.
      const densityThreshold = Math.max(maxDensity * 0.02, 0.01);

      let activeBins = binsInComponent.filter(p => Number(p.density_m2_per_hz) >= densityThreshold);

      // If a very weak component would be over-trimmed, fall back to strictly positive bins.
      if (!activeBins.length) {
        activeBins = binsInComponent.filter(p => Number(p.density_m2_per_hz) > 0);
      }

      if (!activeBins.length) {
        return '—';
      }

      const periods = activeBins
        .map(p => Number(p.period_sec))
        .filter(p => Number.isFinite(p) && p > 0);

      if (!periods.length) {
        return '—';
      }

      const highPeriod = Math.max(...periods);
      const lowPeriod = Math.min(...periods);

      return `${formatComponentPeriodValue(highPeriod)}–${formatComponentPeriodValue(lowPeriod)} s`;
    }

    function renderLiveBuoyComponentCards(data, useMetric) {
      const wrap = document.getElementById('liveBuoyComponentCards');
      wrap.innerHTML = '';

      const components = data.components || [];

      if (!components.length) {
        wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="text-muted small">No separate components detected.</div>';
        return;
      }

      components.forEach(c => {
        const dir = c.direction_deg == null
          ? 'Direction unavailable'
          : `${c.direction_deg}° ${c.direction_compass || ''}`;

        const height = useMetric ? `${c.height_m} m` : `${c.height_ft} ft`;
        const energy = c.energy_percent == null ? '—' : `${c.energy_percent}% energy`;
        const spread = c.directional_spread_deg == null ? '' : `Spread: ${c.directional_spread_deg}°`;

        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'component-card';

        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="component-title">Component ${c.component}</div>
          <div class="component-type">${componentTypeLabel(c.type)}</div>
          <div class="component-main">${height} @ ${c.peak_period_sec ?? '—'} s</div>
          <div class="component-detail">${dir}</div>
          <div class="component-detail">${componentPeriodRange(c, data.spectrum)}</div>
          <div class="component-meta">
            <span class="component-badge">${energy}</span>
            ${spread ? `<span class="component-badge">${spread}</span>` : ''}
          </div>
        `;

        wrap.appendChild(card);
      });
    }

    function renderLiveBuoyComponentTable(data, useMetric) {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('liveBuoyComponents');
      tbody.innerHTML = '';

      const components = data.components || [];

      if (!components.length) {
        tbody.innerHTML =
          '<tr><td colspan="8" class="text-muted">No separate components detected.</td></tr>';
        return;
      }

      components.forEach(c => {
        const height = useMetric ? `${c.height_m} m` : `${c.height_ft} ft`;

        const dir = c.direction_deg == null
          ? '—'
          : `${c.direction_deg}° ${c.direction_compass || ''}`;

        const energy = c.energy_percent == null ? '—' : `${c.energy_percent}%`;
        const spread = c.directional_spread_deg == null ? '—' : `${c.directional_spread_deg}°`;

        const tr = document.createElement('tr');

        tr.innerHTML = `
          <td>${c.component}</td>
          <td>${componentTypeLabel(c.type)}</td>
          <td>${height}</td>
          <td>${c.peak_period_sec ?? '—'} s</td>
          <td>${dir}</td>
          <td>${energy}</td>
          <td>${componentPeriodRange(c, data.spectrum)}</td>
          <td>${spread}</td>
        `;

        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      });
    }

    function renderLiveSpectrumChart(data) {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('liveSpectrumChart');
      if (!canvas) return;

      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

      if (liveSpectrumChart) {
        liveSpectrumChart.destroy();
      }

      // Plot using frequency as the actual x-value so the curve spacing matches the NOAA spectral plot.
      // The axis labels are converted to period-only labels.
      const spectrum = (data.spectrum || [])
        .filter(p => Number.isFinite(Number(p.frequency_hz)) && Number.isFinite(Number(p.density_m2_per_hz)))
        .sort((a, b) => Number(a.frequency_hz) - Number(b.frequency_hz)); // low frequency/high period on the left

      const periodAxisTicks = [40, 20, 15, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2];
      const periodTickValues = periodAxisTicks.map(period => ({
        period,
        value: 1 / period
      }));

      const xValues = spectrum.map(p => Number(p.frequency_hz));
      const xMin = xValues.length ? Math.min(...xValues) : 0.025;
      const xMax = xValues.length ? Math.max(...xValues) : 0.58;

      liveSpectrumChart = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
          datasets: [{
            label: 'Spectral density',
            data: spectrum.map(p => ({
              x: Number(p.frequency_hz),
              y: Number(p.density_m2_per_hz)
            })),
            showLine: true,
            pointRadius: 2,
            borderWidth: 2,
            tension: 0.25
          }]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          animation: false,
          parsing: false,
          plugins: {
            legend: {
              display: false
            },
            tooltip: {
              callbacks: {
                title: items => {
                  const i = items[0].dataIndex;
                  const p = spectrum[i] || {};
                  return `${formatComponentPeriodValue(p.period_sec)} sec`;
                },
                label: item => {
                  const i = item.dataIndex;
                  const p = spectrum[i] || {};
                  const lines = [`Density: ${item.formattedValue} m²/Hz`];

                  if (p.direction_deg != null) {
                    lines.push(`Direction: ${p.direction_deg}°`);
                  }

                  if (p.r1 != null) {
                    lines.push(`r1: ${p.r1}`);
                  }

                  if (p.r2 != null) {
                    lines.push(`r2: ${p.r2}`);
                  }

                  return lines;
                }
              }
            }
          },
          scales: {
            x: {
              type: 'linear',
              min: xMin,
              max: xMax,
              afterBuildTicks: scale => {
                scale.ticks = periodTickValues
                  .filter(t => t.value >= scale.min && t.value <= scale.max)
                  .map(t => ({
                    value: t.value,
                    period: t.period
                  }));
              },
              grid: {
                display: true
              },
              ticks: {
                autoSkip: false,
                maxRotation: 0,
                minRotation: 0,
                callback: function(value, index, ticks) {
                  return ticks[index]?.period?.toString() || '';
                }
              },
              title: {
                display: true,
                text: 'Period, seconds'
              }
            },
            y: {
              beginAtZero: true,
              title: {
                display: true,
                text: 'Energy density, m²/Hz'
              }
            }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function renderLiveBuoyDetails(data) {
      lastLiveComponentData = data;

      const useMetric = getSelectedUnit() === 'Metric';

      document.getElementById('liveBuoyTotal').textContent =
        formatTotalHeight(data, useMetric);

      document.getElementById('liveBuoyTime').textContent =
        data.timestamp_local || data.timestamp_utc || '—';

      document.getElementById('liveBuoyComponentCount').textContent =
        (data.components || []).length;

      renderLiveBuoyComponentCards(data, useMetric);
      renderLiveBuoyComponentTable(data, useMetric);
      renderLiveSpectrumChart(data);

      document.getElementById('liveBuoyLoading').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('liveBuoyError').classList.add('d-none');
      document.getElementById('liveBuoyContent').classList.remove('d-none');
    }

    function noaaHeight(value, useMetric) {
      if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
        return '';
      }

      const n = parseFloat(value);

      if (!Number.isFinite(n)) {
        return value;
      }

      return useMetric
        ? (n * 0.3048).toFixed(2)
        : n.toFixed(1);
    }

    function noaaHeightWithUnit(value, useMetric) {
      const formatted = noaaHeight(value, useMetric);

      if (!formatted) {
        return '—';
      }

      return formatted + ' ' + (useMetric ? 'm' : 'ft');
    }

    function renderNoaaWaveSummary(data) {
      lastNoaaWaveSummaryData = data;

      const latest = data.latest || {};
      const useMetric = getSelectedUnit() === 'Metric';
      const heightUnit = useMetric ? 'm' : 'ft';

      const wvhtUnit = document.getElementById('noaaWvhtUnit');
      const swhUnit = document.getElementById('noaaSwhUnit');
      const wwhUnit = document.getElementById('noaaWwhUnit');

      if (wvhtUnit) wvhtUnit.textContent = heightUnit;
      if (swhUnit) swhUnit.textContent = heightUnit;
      if (wwhUnit) wwhUnit.textContent = heightUnit;

      document.getElementById('noaaWvht').textContent =
        noaaHeightWithUnit(latest.wvht, useMetric);

      document.getElementById('noaaSwell').textContent =
        noaaHeightWithUnit(latest.swh, useMetric) +
        ' @ ' +
        (latest.swp || '—') +
        ' s ' +
        (latest.swd || '');

      document.getElementById('noaaWindWave').textContent =
        noaaHeightWithUnit(latest.wwh, useMetric) +
        ' @ ' +
        (latest.wwp || '—') +
        ' s ' +
        (latest.wwd || '');

      document.getElementById('noaaWaveSummaryAsOf').textContent =
        (data.title || data.station || '') +
        ' | ' +
        (data.as_of_local || '') +
        ' ' +
        (data.as_of_gmt || '');

      const tbody = document.getElementById('noaaWaveSummaryRows');
      tbody.innerHTML = '';

      const rows = data.rows || [];

      if (!rows.length) {
        tbody.innerHTML =
          '<tr><td colspan="11" class="text-muted">No NOAA wave summary rows parsed.</td></tr>';
        return;
      }

      rows.forEach(r => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');

        tr.innerHTML = `
          <td>${r.date || ''}</td>
          <td>${r.time || ''}</td>
          <td>${noaaHeight(r.wvht, useMetric)}</td>
          <td>${noaaHeight(r.swh, useMetric)}</td>
          <td>${r.swp || ''}</td>
          <td>${r.swd || ''}</td>
          <td>${noaaHeight(r.wwh, useMetric)}</td>
          <td>${r.wwp || ''}</td>
          <td>${r.wwd || ''}</td>
          <td>${r.steepness || ''}</td>
          <td>${r.apd || ''}</td>
        `;

        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      });
    }

    // Dispatch on source: NDBC keeps the rich NOAA summary + spectral-partition panel;
    // every other source (CDIP / AODN / QLD / AusWaves) gets the adaptive bulk panel.
    function loadLiveBuoyDetails(station) {
      const seq = ++liveDetailSeq;
      try { document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('allshore:livepanel')); } catch (e) {}   // the panel opens for a buoy (every source): bring it forward
      const src = (station.source || '').toUpperCase();
      if (src === 'NDBC' || /^ndbc:/i.test(station.id || '')) {
        return loadNdbcBuoyDetails(station, seq);
      }
      return loadGenericBuoyDetails(station, seq);
    }

    async function loadNdbcBuoyDetails(station, seq) {
      showLiveBuoyPanelLoading(station);
      const stale = () => seq !== liveDetailSeq;   // superseded or panel closed

      // Merged-feed ids are namespaced ("ndbc:46221"); the NDBC routes want the raw id.
      const rawId = (station.id || '').replace(/^ndbc:/i, '');

      // Both requests start together (they were sequential); the summary still decides what
      // is shown first. The noop catch keeps an unused/failed components request quiet --
      // the real failure handling happens where it is awaited below.
      const summaryRequest = fetch('/api/ndbc/station/' + encodeURIComponent(rawId) + '/wave-summary');
      const componentRequest = fetch('/api/ndbc/station/' + encodeURIComponent(rawId) + '/components');
      componentRequest.catch(function () {});

      try {
        const summaryResponse = await summaryRequest;

        const summaryData = await summaryResponse.json();
        if (stale()) return;

        if (!summaryResponse.ok || summaryData.error) {
          throw new Error(summaryData.error || 'Unable to load NOAA wave summary.');
        }

        // Nothing within the freshness window -> show "No Recent Reports" only.
        // Skip the spectral fetch too: those files are just as stale.
        if (summaryData.no_recent_reports) {
          lastNoaaWaveSummaryData = summaryData;
          lastLiveComponentData = null;
          lastNoRecentStation = station;
          showLiveBuoyNoRecent(summaryData, station);
          return;
        }
        lastNoRecentStation = null;

        renderNoaaWaveSummary(summaryData);

        try {
          const componentResponse = await componentRequest;

          const componentData = await componentResponse.json();
          if (stale()) return;

          // The spectral files can lag the .spec summary; don't render a stale
          // snapshot next to fresh summary values.
          if (componentResponse.ok && !componentData.error && !componentData.no_recent_reports) {
            // Make sure Chart.js is present for the spectrum plot; if the load fails the
            // render throws exactly as it would have with the CDN down before.
            try { await loadChartJs(); } catch (chartErr) {}
            if (stale()) return;
            renderLiveBuoyDetails(componentData);
          }
        } catch (componentErr) {
          console.warn('Experimental spectral component load failed:', componentErr);
        }
        if (stale()) return;

        document.getElementById('liveBuoyLoading').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('liveBuoyError').classList.add('d-none');
        document.getElementById('liveBuoyGeneric').classList.add('d-none');
        document.getElementById('liveBuoyContent').classList.remove('d-none');

      } catch (err) {
        if (stale()) return;
        showLiveBuoyError(err.message);
      }
    }

    // ---- Adaptive bulk panel (non-NDBC sources) ----
    function fmtHeightM(m, useMetric) {
      const n = Number(m);
      if (m === null || m === undefined || !Number.isFinite(n)) return '—';
      return useMetric ? n.toFixed(2) + ' m' : (n * 3.28084).toFixed(1) + ' ft';
    }
    function fmtPeriod(s) {
      const n = Number(s);
      return Number.isFinite(n) ? n.toFixed(1) + ' s' : '—';
    }
    function fmtDir(d) {
      const n = Number(d);
      if (d === null || d === undefined || !Number.isFinite(n)) return '—';
      return Math.round(((n % 360) + 360) % 360) + '° ' + compassPoint(n);
    }
    function fmtTemp(c, useMetric) {
      const n = Number(c);
      if (c === null || c === undefined || !Number.isFinite(n)) return '—';
      return useMetric ? n.toFixed(1) + ' °C' : (n * 9 / 5 + 32).toFixed(1) + ' °F';
    }
    function relativeAge(iso) {
      const t = Date.parse(iso);
      if (!Number.isFinite(t)) return iso || '—';
      const mins = Math.max(0, Math.round((Date.now() - t) / 60000));
      if (mins < 60) return mins + ' min ago';
      const hrs = Math.round(mins / 60);
      if (hrs < 48) return hrs + ' h ago';
      return Math.round(hrs / 24) + ' d ago';
    }

    // Format a UTC ISO time in a specific IANA zone (the buoy's own zone); falls back
    // to the viewer's local zone when tz is missing.
    function fmtTimeInTz(iso, tz) {
      const d = new Date(iso);
      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '—';
      const opts = { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' };
      if (tz) opts.timeZone = tz;
      try { return d.toLocaleString([], opts); }
      catch (e) { delete opts.timeZone; return d.toLocaleString([], opts); }
    }
    // Short zone abbreviation (e.g. "AEST", "AWST", "GMT+10") for a given time + zone. A nautical zone reads as the
    // forecast window writes it ("Etc/GMT+8" -> "UTC−8", not Intl's "GMT-8": one name on one screen, G22 R-B4).
    function tzAbbr(iso, tz) {
      if (/^Etc\//.test(tz || '') && window.AllshoreForecast && window.AllshoreForecast.zoneLabel) return window.AllshoreForecast.zoneLabel(tz);
      try {
        const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US',
          { timeZone: tz || undefined, timeZoneName: 'short' }).formatToParts(new Date(iso));
        return (parts.find(p => p.type === 'timeZoneName') || {}).value || '';
      } catch (e) { return ''; }
    }

    function buildRecentTable(recent, useMetric, tz) {
      if (!recent || !recent.length) return '';
      const hasPeriod = recent.some(o => o.mean_period_s != null || o.tz_s != null);
      const hasSST = recent.some(o => o.sst_c != null);
      const heightUnit = useMetric ? 'm' : 'ft';
      const tempUnit = useMetric ? '°C' : '°F';
      const abbr = tzAbbr(recent[0].time_utc, tz);

      const head =
        '<tr><th>Time' + (abbr ? '<br><span class="small">' + abbr + '</span>' : '') + '</th>' +
        '<th>Hs<br><span class="small">' + heightUnit + '</span></th>' +
        '<th>Tp<br><span class="small">sec</span></th>' +
        (hasPeriod ? '<th>Avg Pd<br><span class="small">sec</span></th>' : '') +
        '<th>Dir</th>' +
        (hasSST ? '<th>SST<br><span class="small">' + tempUnit + '</span></th>' : '') + '</tr>';

      const body = recent.map(o => {
        const pd = (o.tz_s != null) ? o.tz_s : o.mean_period_s;
        return '<tr>' +
          '<td class="text-nowrap">' + (o.time_utc ? fmtTimeInTz(o.time_utc, tz) : '—') + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + fmtHeightM(o.hs_m, useMetric).replace(' ' + heightUnit, '') + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + (Number.isFinite(Number(o.tp_s)) ? Number(o.tp_s).toFixed(1) : '—') + '</td>' +
          (hasPeriod ? '<td>' + (Number.isFinite(Number(pd)) ? Number(pd).toFixed(1) : '—') + '</td>' : '') +
          '<td class="text-nowrap">' + fmtDir(o.dir_deg) + '</td>' +
          (hasSST ? '<td>' + (Number.isFinite(Number(o.sst_c)) ? fmtTemp(o.sst_c, useMetric).replace(' ' + tempUnit, '') : '—') + '</td>' : '') +
          '</tr>';
      }).join('');

      return '<h6 class="mt-3 mb-2">Recent observations (last 24 h)</h6>' +
        '<div class="table-responsive" style="max-height:260px;overflow-y:auto;">' +
        '<table class="table table-sm table-bordered align-middle mb-0">' +
        '<thead class="table-light">' + head + '</thead><tbody>' + body + '</tbody></table></div>';
    }

    // Swell / wind-sea component table (a 2-way sea/swell split, or NDBC-style
    // multi-partition components — same shape either way: [{label,hs_m,period_s,dir_deg,spread_deg}]).
    function buildPartitionTable(partitions, useMetric, title) {
      if (!partitions || !partitions.length) return '';
      const hasSpread = partitions.some(p => p.spread_deg != null);
      const hasEnergy = partitions.some(p => p.energy_pct != null);
      const rows = partitions.map(p =>
        '<tr><td class="text-nowrap"><strong>' + p.label + '</strong></td>' +
        '<td>' + fmtHeightM(p.hs_m, useMetric) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + fmtPeriod(p.period_s) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="text-nowrap">' + fmtDir(p.dir_deg) + '</td>' +
        (hasSpread ? '<td>' + (Number.isFinite(Number(p.spread_deg)) ? Math.round(p.spread_deg) + '°' : '—') + '</td>' : '') +
        (hasEnergy ? '<td>' + (Number.isFinite(Number(p.energy_pct)) ? Math.round(p.energy_pct) + '%' : '—') + '</td>' : '') +
        '</tr>'
      ).join('');
      return '<h6 class="mt-3 mb-2">' + (title || 'Wave components') + '</h6>' +
        '<table class="table table-sm table-bordered align-middle mb-2" style="max-width:600px;">' +
        '<thead class="table-light"><tr><th>Component</th><th>Height</th><th>Period</th><th>Direction</th>' +
        (hasSpread ? '<th>Spread</th>' : '') + (hasEnergy ? '<th>Energy</th>' : '') +
        '</tr></thead><tbody>' + rows + '</tbody></table>';
    }

    // NDBC-style swell + wind-sea components OVER TIME. rows: [{time_utc, hs_m,
    // swell:{hs_m,period_s,dir_deg}, windsea:{hs_m,period_s,dir_deg}}], newest first.
    function buildSwellTable(rows, useMetric, tz) {
      rows = (rows || []).filter(r => r && (r.swell || r.windsea));
      if (!rows.length) return '';
      const hu = useMetric ? 'm' : 'ft';
      const abbr = tzAbbr(rows[0].time_utc, tz);
      const H = v => Number.isFinite(Number(v)) ? fmtHeightM(v, useMetric).replace(' ' + hu, '') : '—';
      const P = v => Number.isFinite(Number(v)) ? Number(v).toFixed(1) : '—';
      const D = v => Number.isFinite(Number(v)) ? (Math.round(v) + '° ' + compassPoint(v)) : '—';
      const body = rows.map(r => {
        const sw = r.swell || {}, ws = r.windsea || {};
        return '<tr><td class="text-nowrap">' + (r.time_utc ? fmtTimeInTz(r.time_utc, tz) : '—') + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + H(r.hs_m) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + H(sw.hs_m) + '</td><td>' + P(sw.period_s) + '</td><td class="text-nowrap">' + D(sw.dir_deg) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + H(ws.hs_m) + '</td><td>' + P(ws.period_s) + '</td><td class="text-nowrap">' + D(ws.dir_deg) + '</td></tr>';
      }).join('');
      return '<h6 class="mt-3 mb-2">Swell & wind-sea (last 24 h)</h6>' +
        '<div class="table-responsive" style="max-height:280px;overflow-y:auto;">' +
        '<table class="table table-sm table-bordered align-middle mb-0">' +
        '<thead class="table-light"><tr>' +
        '<th rowspan="2" class="align-middle">Time' + (abbr ? '<br><span class="small">' + abbr + '</span>' : '') + '</th>' +
        '<th rowspan="2" class="align-middle">Hs<br><span class="small">' + hu + '</span></th>' +
        '<th colspan="3" class="text-center">Swell</th><th colspan="3" class="text-center">Wind sea</th></tr>' +
        '<tr><th>H<br><span class="small">' + hu + '</span></th><th>P<br><span class="small">s</span></th><th>Dir</th>' +
        '<th>H<br><span class="small">' + hu + '</span></th><th>P<br><span class="small">s</span></th><th>Dir</th></tr>' +
        '</thead><tbody>' + body + '</tbody></table></div>';
    }

    // AusWaves carries the 2-way split in every recent obs row -> build the over-time table.
    function recentToSummary(recent) {
      const out = [];
      (recent || []).forEach(o => {
        if (!o.partitions) return;
        const sw = o.partitions.find(p => p.label === 'Swell');
        const ws = o.partitions.find(p => p.label === 'Wind sea');
        if (!sw && !ws) return;
        out.push({
          time_utc: o.time_utc, hs_m: o.hs_m,
          swell: sw ? { hs_m: sw.hs_m, period_s: sw.period_s, dir_deg: sw.dir_deg } : null,
          windsea: ws ? { hs_m: ws.hs_m, period_s: ws.period_s, dir_deg: ws.dir_deg } : null
        });
      });
      return out;
    }

    // ---- AODN directional-spectrum rendering (partitions + spectral-density chart) ----
    let genericSpectrumChart = null;
    let lastGenericSpectra = null;

    function renderGenericSpectrumChart(spectrum) {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('genericSpectrumCanvas');
      if (!canvas || typeof Chart === 'undefined') return;
      if (genericSpectrumChart) { genericSpectrumChart.destroy(); genericSpectrumChart = null; }
      const spec = (spectrum || [])
        .filter(p => Number.isFinite(Number(p.frequency_hz)) && Number.isFinite(Number(p.density_m2_per_hz)))
        .sort((a, b) => Number(a.frequency_hz) - Number(b.frequency_hz));
      if (!spec.length) return;
      const periodTicks = [40, 20, 15, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2].map(period => ({ period, value: 1 / period }));
      const xv = spec.map(p => Number(p.frequency_hz));
      const xMin = Math.min(...xv), xMax = Math.max(...xv);
      genericSpectrumChart = new Chart(canvas.getContext('2d'), {
        type: 'line',
        data: { datasets: [{ label: 'Spectral density', tension: 0.25, showLine: true, pointRadius: 2, borderWidth: 2,
          data: spec.map(p => ({ x: Number(p.frequency_hz), y: Number(p.density_m2_per_hz) })) }] },
        options: {
          responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, animation: false, parsing: false,
          plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: {
            title: items => `${formatComponentPeriodValue((spec[items[0].dataIndex] || {}).period_sec)} sec`,
            label: item => {
              const p = spec[item.dataIndex] || {};
              const l = ['Density: ' + item.formattedValue + ' m²/Hz'];
              if (p.direction_deg != null) l.push('Direction: ' + p.direction_deg + '°');
              return l;
            } } } },
          scales: {
            x: { type: 'linear', min: xMin, max: xMax,
              afterBuildTicks: scale => { scale.ticks = periodTicks.filter(t => t.value >= scale.min && t.value <= scale.max).map(t => ({ value: t.value, period: t.period })); },
              ticks: { autoSkip: false, maxRotation: 0, minRotation: 0, callback: (v, i, ticks) => (ticks[i] && ticks[i].period != null ? ticks[i].period.toString() : '') },
              title: { display: true, text: 'Period, seconds' } },
            y: { beginAtZero: true, title: { display: true, text: 'Energy density, m²/Hz' } }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function renderGenericSpectra(data, useMetric, tz) {
      lastGenericSpectra = data;
      const host = document.getElementById('genericSpectra');
      if (!host || !data) return;
      const parts = (data.components || []).map(c => ({
        label: c.type === 'wind sea' ? 'Wind sea'
          : (c.type ? c.type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.type.slice(1) : 'Component'),
        hs_m: c.height_m, period_s: c.peak_period_sec, dir_deg: c.direction_deg,
        spread_deg: c.directional_spread_deg, energy_pct: c.energy_percent
      }));
      host.innerHTML =
        buildSwellTable(data.summary, useMetric, tz) +
        buildPartitionTable(parts, useMetric, 'Current components (directional spectrum)') +
        '<h6 class="mt-3 mb-2">Spectral density (latest)</h6>' +
        '<div style="position:relative;height:200px;"><canvas id="genericSpectrumCanvas"></canvas></div>';
      renderGenericSpectrumChart(data.spectrum);
    }

    function renderGenericBuoy(payload, station) {
      lastGenericBuoy = { payload: payload, station: station };

      const useMetric = getSelectedUnit() === 'Metric';
      const o = (payload && payload.latest) || null;
      // Prefer the per-station capabilities (the /latest route only carries the
      // provider's class-level defaults, which don't know which buoys have spectra).
      const caps = (station && station.capabilities) || (payload && payload.capabilities) || {};
      const el = document.getElementById('liveBuoyGeneric');

      // innerHTML below replaces the spectra canvas; drop the stale chart instance.
      if (genericSpectrumChart) { genericSpectrumChart.destroy(); genericSpectrumChart = null; }

      if (!o) {
        el.innerHTML = '<div class="text-muted">No recent observation is available for this buoy.</div>';
      } else {
        const metrics = [['Sig. Height', fmtHeightM(o.hs_m, useMetric)]];
        if (o.hmax_m != null) metrics.push(['Max Height', fmtHeightM(o.hmax_m, useMetric)]);
        metrics.push(['Peak Period', fmtPeriod(o.tp_s)]);
        if (o.mean_period_s != null) metrics.push(['Mean Period', fmtPeriod(o.mean_period_s)]);
        if (o.tz_s != null) metrics.push(['Zero-cross Tz', fmtPeriod(o.tz_s)]);
        metrics.push(['Direction', fmtDir(o.dir_deg)]);
        if (o.dir_spread_deg != null && Number.isFinite(Number(o.dir_spread_deg)))
          metrics.push(['Dir. Spread', Math.round(o.dir_spread_deg) + '°']);
        if (o.sst_c != null) metrics.push(['Sea Temp', fmtTemp(o.sst_c, useMetric)]);

        const cards = metrics.map(m =>
          `<div class="live-buoy-metric"><div class="label">${m[0]}</div><div class="value fs-6">${m[1]}</div></div>`
        ).join('');

        const tz = (station && station.tz) || null;
        const abbr = o.time_utc ? tzAbbr(o.time_utc, tz) : '';
        const obs = o.time_utc
          ? `${relativeAge(o.time_utc)} · ${fmtTimeInTz(o.time_utc, tz)}${abbr ? ' ' + abbr : ''}`
          : '—';
        const tzNote = (tz && o.time_utc)
          ? `<div class="small text-muted mb-2">Times shown in buoy-local zone: ${tz}${abbr ? ' (' + abbr + ')' : ''}</div>`
          : '';

        const swellRows = recentToSummary(payload.recent);
        const hasParts = swellRows.length > 0;
        const hasHistory = payload.recent && payload.recent.length;
        el.innerHTML =
          `<div class="live-buoy-summary mb-2">${cards}</div>` +
          `<div class="small text-muted mb-1">Observed: ${obs}</div>` +
          tzNote +
          buildSwellTable(swellRows, useMetric, tz) +
          buildRecentTable(payload.recent, useMetric, tz) +
          (!hasHistory
            ? '<div class="small text-muted mt-2">Latest reading shown — this source does not publish recent history openly.</div>'
            : '') +
          (caps.spectra ? '' :
            (hasParts
              ? '<div class="small text-muted mt-2">Swell / wind-sea split from the buoy (2 components). Full directional spectra are not published for this buoy.</div>'
              : '<div class="small text-muted mt-2">Spectral / directional-partition data is not published for this buoy — bulk wave parameters only.</div>')) +
          (payload.attribution_text
            ? `<div class="small text-muted mt-2">${payload.attribution_text}</div>` : '');
      }

      // Placeholder filled later by renderGenericSpectra() for spectra-capable buoys.
      el.innerHTML += '<div id="genericSpectra"></div>';

      document.getElementById('liveBuoyLoading').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('liveBuoyError').classList.add('d-none');
      document.getElementById('liveBuoyContent').classList.add('d-none');
      el.classList.remove('d-none');
    }

    async function loadGenericBuoyDetails(station, seq) {
      showLiveBuoyPanelLoading(station);
      const stale = () => seq !== liveDetailSeq;   // superseded or panel closed
      lastGenericSpectra = null;
      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/api/buoys/' + encodeURIComponent(station.id) + '/latest');
        const payload = await resp.json();
        if (stale()) return;
        if (!resp.ok || payload.error) {
          throw new Error(payload.error || 'Unable to load buoy observation.');
        }
        renderGenericBuoy(payload, station);

        // Spectra-capable buoys (AODN): pull the directional spectrum -> NDBC-style
        // partitions + spectral-density chart. Optional/lazy — never blocks the bulk view.
        if (station.capabilities && station.capabilities.spectra) {
          try {
            const cr = await fetch('/api/buoys/' + encodeURIComponent(station.id) + '/components');
            if (cr.ok) {
              const cdata = await cr.json();
              if (stale()) return;
              if (!cdata.error) {
                try { await loadChartJs(); } catch (chartErr) {}
                if (stale()) return;
                renderGenericSpectra(cdata, getSelectedUnit() === 'Metric', station.tz);
              }
            }
          } catch (specErr) {
            console.warn('Spectral partition load failed:', specErr);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (stale()) return;
        showLiveBuoyError(err.message);
      }
    }

    const unitSelect = document.getElementById('unit');

    if (unitSelect) {
      unitSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
        // A "No Recent Reports" panel has no values to convert -- keep it as-is.
        if (lastNoRecentStation) {
          showLiveBuoyNoRecent(lastNoaaWaveSummaryData, lastNoRecentStation);
          return;
        }

        if (lastNoaaWaveSummaryData) {
          renderNoaaWaveSummary(lastNoaaWaveSummaryData);
        }

        if (lastLiveComponentData) {
          // Re-render reads the CURRENT unit at render time, so a toggle made while
          // Chart.js is still loading is never lost -- it is applied once the load settles.
          const rerender = () => { if (lastLiveComponentData) renderLiveBuoyDetails(lastLiveComponentData); };
          if (window.Chart) rerender(); else loadChartJs().then(rerender, rerender);
        }

        if (lastGenericBuoy) {
          const keepSpectra = lastGenericSpectra;
          const stTz = lastGenericBuoy.station && lastGenericBuoy.station.tz;
          renderGenericBuoy(lastGenericBuoy.payload, lastGenericBuoy.station);
          if (keepSpectra) {
            const rerenderSpectra = () => {
              if (lastGenericSpectra === keepSpectra) renderGenericSpectra(keepSpectra, getSelectedUnit() === 'Metric', stTz);
            };
            if (window.Chart) rerenderSpectra(); else loadChartJs().then(rerenderSpectra, rerenderSpectra);
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function createLiveBuoyIcon(isActive = false) {
      const size = isActive ? 15 : 11;
      const centerOffsetPx = isActive ? 8 : 7;
      const anchorX = Math.round((size / 2) - centerOffsetPx);

      return L.divIcon({
        className: 'live-buoy-div-icon',
        html: `
          <span class="live-buoy-dot" style="
            width:${size}px;
            height:${size}px;
            background:#00E5FF;
            border:${isActive ? '3px solid #ffffff' : '2px solid #ffffff'};
            box-shadow:${isActive ? '0 0 10px rgba(0, 229, 255, 1)' : '0 0 6px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.9)'};
          "></span>
        `,
        iconSize: [size, size],

        // Places the live buoy about 7–8 px right of the actual coordinate.
        // Close enough to visually pair with the forecast buoy, but separated enough to click.
        iconAnchor: [anchorX, Math.round(size / 2)]
      });
    }

    // Build the two icon variants once and reuse them, instead of allocating a
    // fresh divIcon (with a box-shadow) for every marker on every rebuild.
    const liveBuoyIconInactive = createLiveBuoyIcon(false);
    const liveBuoyIconActive = createLiveBuoyIcon(true);

    function rebuildLiveBuoyMarkers(force = false) {
      const vis = visibleCopies(liveStationsData);
      // The active-buoy highlight changes the icon, so fold it into the signature.
      const sig = (activeLiveBuoyId || '') + '|' + renderSignature(vis);
      if (!force && sig === lastLiveSig) return;
      lastLiveSig = sig;

      liveBuoyLayer.clearLayers();

      vis.forEach(function (c) {
        const s = c.s;
        const label = 'Live ' + buoyDisplayLabel(s) + (s.source ? ' (' + s.source + ')' : '');
        const marker = L.marker([s.lat, c.lng], {
          icon: s.id === activeLiveBuoyId ? liveBuoyIconActive : liveBuoyIconInactive,
          title: label,
          zIndexOffset: 500
        }).addTo(liveBuoyLayer);

        marker.bindTooltip(textTip(label), {                       // a provider's station name: text, never HTML (G22 A-20)
          permanent: false,
          direction: 'top',
          offset: [12, -2]
        });

        marker.on('click', function (e) {
          if (window.AllshoreTools && window.AllshoreTools.active()) { window.AllshoreTools.click(e.latlng, e.originalEvent); return; }   // markers do not pass clicks to the map
          activeLiveBuoyId = s.id;
          rebuildLiveBuoyMarkers(true);
          saveMapView(map);
          saveLayerVisibility();
          loadLiveBuoyDetails(s);
        });
      });
    }

    // Wire map movement after all wrapped-marker state and rebuild functions exist.
    map.on('moveend', handleMapMoveEnd);
    map.on('zoomend', clampMapLatitude);

    window.addEventListener('resize', enforceSingleWorld);
    enforceSingleWorld();

    // ---------------- Favorite-station picker ----------------
    // Progressive enhancement over the native <select id="station">: the trigger
    // shows the current station (+ a ★ to favorite it) and opens a panel listing
    // saved favorites for one-tap selection. Most buoys are picked on the map; this
    // box is for quick re-access. The native select stays the real form field
    // (no-JS fallback) and ?station=... deep links are unaffected.
    (function initStationPicker() {
      const field = document.querySelector('.station-field');
      const select = document.getElementById('station');
      const trigger = document.getElementById('stationTrigger');
      const favToggle = document.getElementById('stationFavToggle');
      const currentEl = document.getElementById('stationCurrent');
      const results = document.getElementById('stationResults');
      const status = document.getElementById('stationStatus');
      if (!field || !select || !trigger || !favToggle || !currentEl || !results || !select.options.length) return;

      // every option of the select, the stations and My points (the page block adds those as an optgroup and says
      // so with 'allshore:points')
      let bySid = null;
      function index() {
        bySid = new Map(Array.from(select.options).filter(function (o) { return !o.hasAttribute('data-unknown'); }).map(function (o) {
          return [o.value, { sid: o.value, label: (o.textContent || '').trim() }];
        }));
      }
      index();
      // My points (plan section 31): the store and its sync, set by the page block after static_ui/forecast.js
      function points() { return window.__allshorePoints || null; }
      function isPoint(sid) { return typeof sid === 'string' && sid.indexOf('pt_') === 0; }

      const FAV_KEY = 'allshore.favStations.v1';
      function readFavs() {
        try { const a = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FAV_KEY)); return Array.isArray(a) ? a.filter(function (x) { return typeof x === 'string'; }) : []; }
        catch (e) { return []; }
      }
      function writeFavs(arr) { try { localStorage.setItem(FAV_KEY, JSON.stringify(arr.slice(0, 100))); } catch (e) {} }
      function isFav(sid) { return readFavs().indexOf(sid) !== -1; }
      function toggleFav(sid) { let f = readFavs(); if (f.indexOf(sid) !== -1) f = f.filter(function (x) { return x !== sid; }); else f.unshift(sid); writeFavs(f); }

      // Enhance: reveal the favorites box, hide the native select, point the label at the trigger.
      field.classList.add('js-picker');
      const label = field.querySelector('label.form-label');
      if (label) label.setAttribute('for', 'stationTrigger');
      function announce(msg) { if (status) status.textContent = msg; }

      function writeLabel(el, text) { if (window.AllshoreForecast && window.AllshoreForecast.writeLabel) window.AllshoreForecast.writeLabel(el, text); else el.textContent = text; }
      function refreshCurrent() {
        const sid = select.value;
        const c = bySid.get(sid);
        writeLabel(currentEl, c ? c.label : (sid || 'Select a station'));         // an id without an option keeps its name (G22 R-A11)
        currentEl.title = c ? c.label : (sid || '');                                      // the whole label, also after a rename (G22 A-14)
        const P = points(), pt = isPoint(sid);
        const fav = !!c && (pt ? !!(P && P.store.has(sid)) : isFav(sid));         // for a point the star is "kept in My points"
        favToggle.textContent = fav ? '★' : '☆';
        favToggle.disabled = !c || (pt && !P) || (pt && !fav && !!(P && P.refused(sid)));   // no forecast there: nothing to keep (G22 A-13)
        favToggle.setAttribute('aria-label', !c ? 'No station selected'
          : pt && !fav && favToggle.disabled ? 'No forecast here, nothing to keep: ' + c.label
          : pt ? (fav ? 'Remove this point from My points: ' : 'Keep this point in My points: ') + c.label
          : (fav ? 'Remove current station from favorites: ' : 'Add current station to favorites: ') + c.label);
      }

      // The list is position: fixed (it escapes the window's overflow): placed from the trigger's box, below it
      // when there is room, else above (the chip and the phone bar sit at the bottom edge); full width on phones.
      function place() {
        const r = trigger.getBoundingClientRect(), s = results.style, vw = window.innerWidth, vh = window.innerHeight;
        if (vw <= 576) { s.left = '8px'; s.width = (vw - 16) + 'px'; }
        else { s.width = ''; s.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(r.left, vw - 8 - 360)) + 'px'; }
        const below = vh - r.bottom - 8, above = r.top - 8;
        if (below >= 220 || below >= above) { s.top = (r.bottom + 2) + 'px'; s.bottom = 'auto'; s.maxHeight = Math.max(120, Math.min(340, below)) + 'px'; }
        else { s.bottom = (vh - r.top + 2) + 'px'; s.top = 'auto'; s.maxHeight = Math.max(120, Math.min(340, above)) + 'px'; }
      }
      function open() { renderFavs(); place(); results.hidden = false; trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true'); }
      function close() { results.hidden = true; trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); }
      window.addEventListener('resize', close);

      function selectStation(sid) {
        if (!bySid.has(sid)) return;
        select.value = sid;
        refreshCurrent();
        close();
        // The forecast window loads it in place and the map recentres on it (no reload).
        document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('allshore:station', { detail: { sid: sid, source: 'picker' } }));
      }

      function head(text) { const li = document.createElement('li'); li.className = 'sr-head'; li.setAttribute('role', 'presentation'); li.textContent = text; results.appendChild(li); }
      // Keep keyboard focus in the panel after a row went away: the next row's pick button (or close if none left).
      function refocus(idx) {
        const next = results.querySelectorAll('.fav-select');
        if (next.length) { (next[idx] || next[next.length - 1]).focus(); }
        else { close(); trigger.focus(); }
      }
      function renderPoints() {
        const P = points(), list = P ? P.store.list() : [];
        if (!list.length) return 0;
        head('My points');
        list.forEach(function (p) {
          const label = window.AllshoreForecast.pointLabel(p);
          const li = document.createElement('li');
          const pick = document.createElement('button');
          pick.type = 'button'; pick.className = 'fav-select'; pick.dataset.sid = p.id; writeLabel(pick, label); pick.title = label;
          pick.addEventListener('click', function () { selectStation(p.id); });
          const ren = document.createElement('button');
          ren.type = 'button'; ren.className = 'pt-act'; ren.textContent = '✎'; ren.title = 'Rename'; ren.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Rename point: ' + label);
          ren.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            const name = window.prompt('A name for this point (40 characters at most; its coordinates stay in the label):', p.name || '');
            if (name === null) return;
            P.store.rename(p.id, name); P.sync(); renderFavs();
            const again = results.querySelector('.fav-select[data-sid="' + p.id + '"]');
            if (again && again.parentNode) again.parentNode.querySelector('.pt-act').focus();
